articleTitle: Facial Expression Recognition Technology in Emotional Monitoring of Young Children
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: In recent years, the importance of children's emotional competence in their personality development has been increasingly emphasized. Understanding children's emotional states is crucial for assessing their social emotional abilities. Facial expressions are one of the important signals reflecting emotional states and have received significant attention due to their ease of accessibility. Facial expression recognition technology is considered an effective tool to better understand and address the emotional states of young children. By analyzing children's facial expressions, this study can accurately capture their emotional changes, thereby enabling timely intervention measures. Although research in the field of facial expression recognition technology is still in its early stages, some initial progress has been made. Establishing a database of children's facial expressions is fundamental to this research, providing rich data resources for this study. Extracting facial expression features is also a key step that directly influences the accuracy and effectiveness of recognition. This research focuses on the monitoring of children's emotions and explores the application of facial expression recognition technology in this field. Firstly, this paper constructs a database of children's expressions, recording the process of changes in their facial expressions. Secondly, this paper proposes a feature extraction scheme to effectively address the issues of extracting expression data caused by complex lighting and backgrounds, thereby improving the accuracy of expression recognition. Thirdly, this paper introduces learning models to enhance the applicability of the models in real-world scenarios. Finally, this paper develops a children's emotion monitoring system, which can real-time locate children's facial areas and identify expression categories, generating emotion maps to assist professionals in social emotional ability assessment. This is of great significance for deepening the understanding of the cultivation and development of children's social emotional abilities, as well as enhancing the monitoring and assessment capabilities of professionals.

articleTitle: Network Resource Optimization Allocation Algorithm Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: With the growth of emerging technologies such as software defined networks, network function virtualization, and fifth generation communication, while improving network flexibility and controllability, it has also brought unprecedented challenges to the efficient adaptation of network resources such as routing, computing, and storage. Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) can establish a trial reward feedback mechanism in a different way from traditional optimization algorithms, accumulate experience for learning, and thus achieve optimization goals. This paper proposes a DRL based network resource allocation algorithm for multi-objective optimization problems in network resource allocation. By combining deep learning (DL) and reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms to construct a neural network, energy efficiency is used as a reward and punishment value, historical data is saved in an experience pool, and the weight parameters of the network are trained using gradient descent method. The algorithm has the ability to autonomously allocate and make decisions, dynamically adjust channel and power allocation according to environmental conditions, and obtain a approximately optimal allocation strategy. The simulation results show that over against other resource allocation methods, the resource allocation method proposed in this paper can effectively improve system throughput, and has good channel adaptability and convergence.

articleTitle: Design of a Confidentiality Intelligent Interaction System Based on SM2, SM3 and SM4 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: This article elaborates on the design and development of a secure intelligence interaction system on the basis of encryption algorithms SM2, SM3 and SM4. The backend of the system is designed using Java programming language combined with MySQL database management system for backend program and data storage. In terms of security performance, the SM4 symmetric encryption algorithm is used to encrypt information, the SM3 algorithm generates a ciphertext message digest to ensure data integrity, and finally, the digest is digitally signed using the SM2 algorithm to provide identity verification and non repudiation, thereby ensuring the security and confidentiality of data transmission in the interactive system. After detailed testing, the design has achieved the predetermined design goals and safety standards.

articleTitle: Eigenvalue Extraction of Automated Pothole Road Image Based on AlexNet Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: In the rapid progress of urbanisation, the safety and smoothness of road traffic has become a problem that needs to be solved by urban management. The pothole problem on the road surface, as one of the main influencing factors of traffic safety and driving comfort, is difficult to guarantee the accuracy and efficiency of the traditional manual visual inspection method. Therefore, this study is dedicated to the automated pothole road detection and recognition technology based on AlexNet model to solve the problems in practical traffic management. We processed two versions of image files, high pixel and low pixel, and built a classification model for pothole situation recognition. Firstly, 301 images were preprocessed into two pixel versions of 256*256 and 512*512 using de-mean, normalisation and batch cropping. Subsequently, we extracted the feature values of the images using the AlexNet model. In the initial feature value extraction, we obtained a feature table of 301*4096 through the convolutional layer part. Then, a feature downscaling step was performed, where features were first extracted from the pooling layer of AlexNet with an output size of 6*6*256. for this, a global average pooling was performed to downsize the 6*6*256 feature map to 11*256. in order to find a more accurate classification model, we performed feature extraction and visualisation on both low and high pixel versions of the data. This process aims to further optimise the performance and accuracy of the model. Therefore, this study not only technically improves the automation of pothole road detection, but also provides a strong support for solving practical problems in urban traffic management through in-depth data processing and model optimisation.

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning in English Language Teaching Quality Assessment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: This article proposes and validates a Machine Learning (ML)-based model for assessing English Language Teaching (ELT) quality, aiming to surpass traditional methods and enhance accuracy and efficiency. Utilizing the robust feature extraction and learning capabilities of Deep Neural Networks (DNN), the model is designed to seamlessly extract pertinent information from intricate ELT datasets and precisely assess teaching quality. Upon comparing the model’s performance across various data types, it is evident that the model excels in accurately capturing semantic nuances within textual data. While its performance is slightly less impressive with numerical data, the overall outcome remains satisfactory. Experimental findings reveal that the DNN model attains remarkable performance on the test set, achieving an accuracy rate of 97%. When pitted against traditional manual and rule-based automatic assessment methods, this model shines in its ability to handle extensive datasets, facilitating batch processing and automated feature extraction. This, in turn, significantly boosts assessment efficiency, offering robust support for large-scale teaching quality evaluations in real-world settings.

articleTitle: Designing and Implementing an Intelligent Machine Learning-Based Evaluation System for Assessing English Teaching Quality in Vocational Education
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: The assessment of teaching quality serves as a crucial metric for evaluating the effectiveness of teachers’ instruction and students’ learning, particularly in the context of vocational education. Given the paramount importance of objectivity and scientific rigor in such evaluations, quantitative methods have garnered significant attention among teaching administrators. However, traditional evaluation techniques often rely heavily on manual, subjective assessments, compromising the accuracy and consistency of the outcomes. To address this issue, this article proposes an intelligent evaluation system tailored for vocational English education, leveraging machine learning (ML) techniques. This system aims to enhance the precision and reliability of evaluations, serving as a robust support mechanism for improving the quality of vocational English instruction. The system operates by automatically collecting and analyzing extensive teaching data, encompassing diverse information ranging from student homework grades to classroom interactions and teacher methodologies. By employing ML algorithms, it constructs an evaluation model that ensures an objective and precise assessment of teaching quality. Experimental findings demonstrate that this system not only boosts evaluation efficiency but also guarantees the objectivity and scientific validity of the results, thereby strengthening the foundation for the continuous enhancement of vocational English teaching quality.

articleTitle: Application and Exploration of Interactive Data Analysis in College Students’ Employment Strategy Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to explore the application of interactive data analysis in college students’ employment strategy recommendation, and verify its effectiveness through empirical research. With the help of various interactive data analysis tools, this paper makes an in-depth analysis of the employment-related data of college students. Firstly, this study quantitatively analyzes the importance of different employment strategies, and finds that online recruitment has the highest importance in college students’ employment, followed by campus recruitment and interpersonal relationship. Then, through interactive data exploration, this study found the differences of different employment channels under different conditions, which provided a useful reference for personalized employment recommendation. Finally, the interactive data analysis tool is used to provide personalized employment strategy recommendations for college students, which improves the possibility of successful employment. The results of this study show that interactive data analysis has important application value in the recommendation of college students’ employment strategies, provides scientific basis and support for college students’ employment choice, and has positive significance for promoting the development of individuals and society.

articleTitle: Research on Construction Method of Distribution Network Digital Twin Space Based on Comprehensive Utilization of Model Resources
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: The operational data of production equipment in the physical world and the twin equipment in the virtual space are interconnected, and real-time visual display driven by data is an important part of the implementation of digital twin technology. Aiming at the problems such as insufficient fusion description and analysis capabilities of digital twin models in the field of distribution network, high cost of refined spatial modeling and mapping, and insufficient operation and deduction capabilities. This paper combines digital technology with distribution network business and proposes a distribution network digital twin space description method and technical architecture with equipment as the core and topology as the carrier. It provides a technical foundation for building power grid status awareness, real-time control and optimization applications for large-scale digital twin aggregation.

articleTitle: Construction of University Data Warehouse Based on Multidimensional Data Computing Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: To meet the needs of universities for integrating, summarizing, and analyzing all operational data generated by various business systems, it is necessary to apply data warehouse technology to complete the collection and governance of business system data, and provide standardized and effective data services for upper-level applications. Based on this, the article combines the characteristics of university business data and practical application needs, and proposes a framework design for the university data warehouse platform. In response to the changing needs of university data analysis and complex statistical characteristics, the article designs a centralized extraction, partitioned governance, and multidimensional modeling construction plan, focusing on analyzing the dimension model construction method of the subject data area, and designing a star model for teacher basic data and a snowflake model for student enrollment data. Finally, it provides a data cleaning strategy, which provides a reference for the construction of university data warehouses.

articleTitle: Dynamic Prediction Algorithm for Load Rejection of Digital Control in Nuclear Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: A nuclear power plant is a complex system that includes multiple interacting subsystems. Dynamic prediction requires processing a large amount of real-time data, including temperature, pressure, flow rate, reactor power, etc. Due to the complexity of the data, the initial state and processing difficulty of the main controller’s load shedding are significant. To this end, design a dynamic prediction algorithm for the digital control of load shedding in nuclear power plants. Introducing the LSTM fusion algorithm, constructing an initial state model of the main controller’s load shedding, and clustering the digital main controller’s load shedding based on MapReduce. Based on this, multiple clustering features are extracted, and a dynamic prediction algorithm for the load shedding of the main control system of a nuclear power plant is designed. The experimental results show that the predictive results of the research algorithm on the digital control load shedding of nuclear power plants have a higher degree of fit with the actual situation, and the determination coefficient is close to 1, indicating that the research algorithm has ideal application effects.

articleTitle: Adaptive Optimization Control Strategy for Intelligent Manufacturing Systems Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: With the vigorous growth of the new generation of information technology, a new round of industrial revolution is sweeping across the world. Governments of various countries are actively introducing policies to promote the transformation and upgrading of manufacturing enterprises. As an inevitable trend in the growth of China’s manufacturing industry, the core of intelligent manufacturing lies in the research and application of adaptive intelligent manufacturing systems. As a key technology for upgrading the manufacturing industry and promoting the integration of informatization and industrialization, the improvement of performance and adaptive capabilities of adaptive intelligent manufacturing systems is crucial. Deep reinforcement learning (DRL), with its powerful decision-making ability and adaptability to complex environments, has shown broad application prospects in the field of intelligent manufacturing. This article proposes an adaptive optimization control strategy for intelligent manufacturing systems based on DRL. This strategy achieves adaptive optimization of manufacturing system control strategies through the powerful representation learning ability of deep neural networks (DNN) and the adaptive decision-making ability of reinforcement learning (RL). The experimental results show that this strategy can significantly improve the adaptive ability and optimization performance of manufacturing systems, enabling them to maintain stable and efficient operation in complex production environments, thereby improving production efficiency, reducing operating costs, and enhancing product quality.

articleTitle: Using GPUs and Neuromorphic Computing for Modern Challenges in Computing Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: The article depicts the evolution of computing architecture, focusing on the challenges posed by the von Neumann architecture in meeting the increased demand for modern computing paradigms like Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence. It discusses the pivotal role of Deep Learning in the progression of Artificial Intelligence and points out the critical factors that support the success of Machine Learning. This article also presents the restriction of the von Neumann architecture in handling complex and a large amount of data efficiently. Hence, some potential and promising solutions and innovations will be explored for enhancing computing power and energy efficiency to face evolving computational requirements. The design of GPU and the idea of neural networks are two main potential directions for prompting and improving modern computing. Nowadays’ the achievement of GPU and neural networks will be discussed by introducing their principles, function, and implementation in the article. Finally, some drawbacks of current achievements and some possible promising ways to improve nowadays technology will be presented.

articleTitle: Challenges and Opportunities of Big Data Technology in the Analysis of Rail Transit Power Supply Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: Faced with the growth of the times, urban rail transit (URT) has become the most distinctive product of contemporary times, and URT can provide great convenience for people’s travel. With the expansion of URT scale and the deepening of informatization, studying the operation and maintenance management of URT power supply equipment under big data conditions is of great significance. The formation and deepening application of power big data have made traditional data batch processing techniques unable to meet the real-time application requirements of current rail transit. The real-time acquisition and correlation calculation of multi-source data have become key factors restricting the comprehensive application of power big data. This article designs a URT power supply data analysis system based on big data technology. The system integrates various data sources and utilizes big data technology to collect, store, process, and analyze power supply data in real-time, extracting valuable information and knowledge, and providing scientific decision-making assistance for rail transit operation and maintenance management. The experimental results show that the system in this article can process massive power supply data, optimize resource allocation, improve the efficiency and service quality of rail transit operations, and bring more opportunities and possibilities for the growth of rail transit.

articleTitle: Use and Maintenance of Automatic Opening and Closing Mechanism for CR200J High-speed Trains
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: The opening and closing mechanism serves as the driving mechanism for the front active cabin door of the high-speed train. During single train operation, it keeps the front active cabin door in a closed state, forming a complete aerodynamic shape of the train, reducing wind resistance and noise; When reconnecting operation is required, keep the front movable cabin door in the open position, so that the hook can be fully and unobstructed coupled, and can adapt to the impact of the hook swing angle when operating on different curve radii. The performance of the opening and closing mechanism directly affects the safety of train operation and the comfort of passengers riding. On the basis of analyzing the structure and working principle of the automatic opening and closing mechanism of the CR200J high-speed train, this article introduces the installation and debugging methods of the automatic opening and closing mechanism, and outlines the maintenance methods for common faults of the automatic opening and closing mechanism.

articleTitle: Correlation between Social Media Behavior and Mental Health of College Students Based on GANs
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: In recent years, social media has become the primary channel for people to express emotions and communicate. With the help of social media behavior (hereinafter referred to as SMB), people can understand users' attitudes and preferences, which is of great significance in fields such as public opinion analysis and advertising recommendation. At the same time, the rapid development of artificial intelligence has sparked a research craze in emotion generation. Social media provides rich data for emotion generation, which helps improve human-computer interaction experiences. However, emotion generation and emotion detection face challenges, one of which is the emotional semantic gap. Research suggests that GANs can learn the overall correlations of data distributions, and reinforcement learning can help handle high-dimensional semantic information. Therefore, based on GANs, this paper explores how to obtain more robust emotional representations in emotion detection and integrate abstract emotional information into the text generation process. Behaviors on social media are also under scrutiny for psychological health and personality prediction. Traditional social cognition is prone to misunderstandings and biases, making it difficult for individuals with mental illnesses to obtain professional assistance. Therefore, social media-based psychological health analysis is of great significance as it can detect psychological disorders early and prevent their deterioration. Effective psychological health analysis requires a thorough understanding of the patient's personality traits to accurately comprehend their behavioral patterns. This paper aims to utilize computational methods and social media data to identify the psychological health and personality traits of college students, in order to improve the social support function of social media and establish an early warning mechanism for psychological health.

articleTitle: Leadership in Community Organizations: Comparison of the Performance of Multilayer Network Centrality Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: In order to explore leadership at different levels in social networks, this article used various types of multi-level network centrality algorithms to analyze. On this basis, the article adopted a multilayer network centrality algorithm, which divided community organizations into different levels and analyzed them as a whole. The multilayer network centrality algorithm was compared and studied on simulated and real data, and its performance was evaluated through experiments. The results showed that the multilayer network centrality algorithm had good performance in analyzing complex multi-level network structures, with the fastest response time reaching 202ms.

articleTitle: Detecting Pulmonary Nodules Using ResNets
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: Lung cancer remains an essential health concern in the worldwide, with early detection of pulmonary nodules being critical for more accurate patient detection outcomes and reduced mortality rates. The application of sophisticated machine learning methods—convolutional neural networks in particularly, or CNNs—for the identification and categorization of lung nodules from medical imaging data has gained popularity in recent years. ResNets comprise one such CNN. The purpose of this research is to dissect the application of ResNets in the revelation of pulmonary nodules, utilizing annotated datasets from Grand Challenge as the primary data source. The study begins with an overview of ResNets and their advantages in handling complex medical imaging data. Subsequently, the research explores how ResNets can be trained and evaluated for pulmonary nodule detection tasks, comparing their performance to existing detection techniques and benchmarks. Additionally, the study examines the significance of feature selection and refinement techniques in improving the accuracy and reliability of ResNet-based models. The findings of this study demonstrate the prospect of ResNets in enhancing the accuracy and efficiency of the detection in pulmonary nodule , contributing to early diagnosis and improved management of lung cancer. However, they also highlight the need for further refinement and optimization to achieve higher levels of accuracy and reliability in clinical settings.

articleTitle: Application of Intelligent Algorithm in Table Tennis Training Data Analysis and Personalized Guidance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: With the improvement of the competitive level of table tennis, traditional training methods have been difficult to meet the needs of precision and personalization. By introducing intelligent algorithm, this study collects and analyzes the training data of table tennis players, including hitting speed, hitting angle, moving trajectory, reaction time and hitting success rate, so as to reveal the technical characteristics and potential problems of players. Using the Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) model to analyze time series data, the model can accurately predict the action sequence of athletes and provide personalized training guidance based on this. The research results show that the intelligent algorithm can effectively identify the advantages and disadvantages of athletes in technology and tactics, and provide targeted improvement suggestions for coaches and athletes. Personalized guidance involves technical action optimization, reaction speed improvement, tactical adjustment and physical and strength training, aiming at improving athletes' competitive performance. Through practical application, this study has confirmed the effectiveness and practicability of intelligent algorithm in table tennis training data analysis and personalized guidance, and provided new ideas and methods for the scientific training and long-term development of table tennis.

articleTitle: Practical Research of Deep Learning Algorithm in Improving the Efficiency of Information Interaction between Network Security and Privacy Protection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of information technology, there is a growing concern for network security and personal privacy protection. This study aims to explore the practical application of deep learning algorithms in enhancing the efficiency of information interaction between network security and privacy protection. Utilizing deep learning as a tool, a joint model based on deep learning is developed to delve into the realms of network security and privacy protection comprehensively. Firstly, the paper examines the current use of deep learning algorithms in network security and proposes enhancement strategies for existing challenges. By refining and enhancing existing deep learning models, a joint deep learning model is introduced, effectively detecting abnormal behaviors and threats in the network, thereby elevating network security. Secondly, the study investigates the role of deep learning algorithms in streamlining the efficiency of privacy protection information exchange. Through the analysis of user behavior patterns and data traffic, a deep learning model for assessing user privacy risks is formulated, enabling timely identification of potential privacy breaches and the implementation of preventive measures. Lastly, a comprehensive evaluation of the joint deep learning model’s performance on training, validation, and test datasets is conducted, comparing it with traditional methods. Experimental results demonstrate the significant improvements achieved by the proposed deep learning model in enhancing the efficiency of information exchange between network security and privacy protection. It provides valuable insights for further research and application in the domain of network security and privacy protection.

articleTitle: Research on the Effectiveness of Data Mining Algorithms in Music Educational Assessment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: With the growth of science and technology in China rapidly, informatization has gradually been widely applied in various fields, which to some extent has led to innovation in China's modern education management on the basis of growth. Educational assessment, as an essential medium between teaching theory and practice, can effectively guide teaching activities from a theoretical perspective and develop effective operational processes and implementation strategies for specific teaching practices. Toaddress the shortcomings in the current assessment stage of music teaching quality in universities and enhance the accuracy of assessment, this paper constructs a music educational assessment model based on data mining (DM) algorithm and deep learning (DL) technology. Through the association rules in DM technology, based on the real grades of college students and the actual grades of teaching assessments, the source data is cleaned and transformed. The Apriori algorithm is used to model the data. Through result analysis and assessment, guidance is provided for teachers and teaching management departments, helping to scientifically plan the key points of teaching management for each semester, further enhance teaching management level, and enhance teaching quality. The experimental results show that the proposed assessment model has good accuracy.

articleTitle: Application of CEEMDAN Combined with Wavelet Packet Transform and ECA-1DCNN in Rolling Bearing Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: In the conventional approach to diagnosing faults in rolling bearings, feature extraction is dependent on manual expertise, making the processing procedure laborious and resulting in limited recognition accuracy. A rolling bearing fault diagnosis method based on CEEMDAN combines wavelet packet transform with ECA-1DCNN method is proposed. In the paper, firstly, the collected vibration sensor signal of rolling bearings are decomposed by wavelet packet to extract the energy characteristics of each spectrum, and the reconstructed signals after initial noise reduction are obtained. Secondly, appropriate Intrinsic Mode Function (IMF) was screened by CEEMDAN algorithm and kurtosis correlation coefficient screening criteria for signal reconstruction. By placing the processed signals into the model of ECA-1DCNN for training, the channel attention mechanism can enable the convolutional neural network to self-adapt attention to more important feature information. Experiments show that the signal obtained by this method can effectively filter out the background noise components, improve the diagnostic resolution of traditional fault diagnosis methods and have a high accuracy, which has practical engineering application value.

articleTitle: Emotion Analysis of Instant Music Video Live Using BERT Model: Emotional Polarity Detection and Emotional Feedback
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: Short video live streaming is a popular form of internet entertainment nowadays. During the live streaming process, there are a large number of user comments, which contain emotional information about the host, content, theme, and other aspects. Emotion analysis based on short video live streaming data can provide more targeted optimization suggestions for live streaming operators, increase live streaming room traffic, and promote emotional communication between hosts and users. The article used the BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) model for emotion analysis of short video live streaming texts. The model was used for feature selection and emotional polarity classification, and the performance of anchors was evaluated through video emotion scoring and feedback mechanisms. The results showed that after conducting emotion analysis, the average popularity of the live broadcast rooms of the five anchors increased from 1.174 million to 1.394 million.

articleTitle: Multi Spectral Imaging Sensor Integration and Optical Path Fusion Based on Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: This paper mentions the wide application of multispectral imaging technology in remote sensing and its importance in different fields. This paper introduces the key functions of machine learning algorithm, and points out that machine learning (ML) algorithm can effectively process multi- spectral data and improve the performance of tasks such as classification, Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) image reconstruction and feature extraction. Finally, the research results indicate that we used different thresholds for anomaly detection and calculated the values of accuracy and precision. When the threshold is 0.00, the accuracy is 0.72 and the precision is 0.68. When the threshold is 0.05, the accuracy is 0.78 and the precision is 0.74. When the threshold is 0.10, the accuracy is 0.82 and the precision is 0.79. From these data, we can observe that as the threshold increases, the accuracy gradually improves, indicating that the model is more accurate in detecting normal land surfaces.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of Student Information Management Database Based on Hibernate
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: Conventional design and optimization of student information management database focuses on data storage and retrieval, ignoring data relevance and business logic processing, which affects the efficiency of database operation. Therefore, a Hibernate based student information management database and optimization method are designed. Design the database structure of student information management, set database table names, field names, data types, constraints and other structures to ensure the integrity of database design. The logical model of student information management database is established based on Hibernate, and data constraints and Hibernate mapping are used to avoid database redundancy. Optimize the execution rules of student information management database, use Hibernate’s characteristics, adjust the database operation strategy, and make the database performance meet the information management requirements. Through comparative experiments, it is verified that the database design and optimization performance of this method is better and can be applied in real life.

articleTitle: A BP Algorithm for Intelligent Improvement of User Experience Interaction Design
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: Ux interaction design, which originated at the intersection of computer science and cognitive psychology, aims to optimize the interaction between humans and machines to provide a more intuitive and satisfying experience. In today' s society, interaction design has the problem of cumbersome algorithm and low efficiency, which has a great impact on user experience. BP algorithm is an effective neural network algorithm, which can improve interaction design. This paper uses BP algorithm to improve user experience interaction design. Finally, through the experiment, the algorithm greatly reduces the complexity of user experience interaction design, simplifies the algorithm, improves the efficiency, the accuracy rate is up to 98.4%, and finally improves the satisfaction of user experience. BP algorithm and user experience interaction design will be widely used in the future.

articleTitle: Research on the Timing Control Technology for High-Quality Seeding in Plug Trays
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: China is the world's largest producer and consumer of vegetables. The demand for fresh vegetables in domestic and international markets is increasing. The demand for leafy vegetables in China is rising year by year. However, due to high labor costs and low production efficiency in vegetable production, vegetable prices are high, which affects the vegetable industry. The key technology of high-quality seeding in trays for multiple varieties is a new highlight of modern agriculture and biotechnology in China. However, the mechanization level of tray seedling machines for facility vegetables in China lags behind, and there is currently no high- quality seeding machine available for different sizes and quantities, which hinders the scale and efficiency development of the facility vegetable tray seedling industry. Based on the trend of tray seeding development, this study focuses on the research of timing control technology for high-quality tray seeding, analyzes the functions of the electronic control system, designs the electrical control schematic and the whole machine control flowchart of a facility vegetable tray seeding machine with XinJie XC-24 as the main controller, designs PLC ladder diagram programs according to the analysis and elaborates on the relevant principles, realizing the timing control technology of the facility vegetable tray seeding machine.

articleTitle: Comparison of FPGA and GPU Architectures in Advancing High Computing Power in Integrated Circuits
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: This manuscript presents a comparative study of FPGA and GPU architectures, highlighting their contributions to enhancing the computing power of integrated circuits. It emphasizes the significance of computing power and offers a comprehensive overview of both FPGA and GPU architectures. The study delves into the critical components and their functional roles within these architectures. It discusses design principles aimed at boosting computing power in FPGAs, along with strategic considerations for maximizing GPU computing power. The manuscript further investigates optimization strategies applicable to both FPGAs and GPUs. Additionally, it explores their application in large-scale data processing and artificial intelligence domains. Empirical results are combined with analytical discourse, leading to a discussion on the future prospects in FPGA and GPU research. The paper concludes by offering insights to guide researchers and practitioners in selecting the most appropriate computing platform for their needs and in advancing the field of integrated circuit design and optimization.

articleTitle: Construction and Communication Strategy of China’s International Image Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: In the context of globalization, the construction and dissemination of national image has become the focus of attention of governments and academia. With the development of big data technology, it provides new opportunities and challenges for the construction and dissemination of China’s international image. The overall evaluation of China’s international image from 2013 to 2022 is mainly positive, and the popularity of China’s international image is relatively high, ranking first among the big countries. By analysing the application of MapReduce technology in the construction and dissemination of China’s international image, this paper proposes strategies for the construction and dissemination of China’s international image based on big data technology, including strategies to improve the affinity of China’s image, to improve the appeal of Chinese culture, and to improve the guidance of international public opinion, aiming to provide a useful reference for the shaping and dissemination of China’s international image.

articleTitle: Optimizing the Training Scheme of Track Athletes with Reinforcement Learning Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: The training scheme of track athletes is very important to improve their competitive level. The purpose of this study is to explore the application of reinforcement learning (RL) technology in optimizing the training scheme of track athletes. By designing and implementing the depth RL (DRL) model, this paper studies and compares its performance with the traditional training scheme in improving athletes’ competitive level and training effect. The experimental results show that the training scheme using DRL model has obvious advantages in many indexes. DRL model can better fit the training data, has better generalization ability, and can achieve better prediction performance on unseen data. In addition, the training scheme using DRL model can significantly improve athletes’ competitive level and bring positive effects on their career and competition results. To sum up, this study verifies the effectiveness and feasibility of DRL technology in optimizing the training scheme of track athletes, and provides new ideas and methods for future training strategies and technologies.

articleTitle: Application of Adaptive Deep Learning Algorithm in Multi-modal Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy and efficiency of multimodal image recognition, the adaptive deep learning algorithm is adopted. By analyzing the development course of adaptive algorithm, compared with the traditional deep learning algorithm, and the present situation and challenges of multimodal image recognition, this paper discusses the adaptive deep learning algorithm in the key technology of multimodal image recognition, implementation, optimization strategy and its practical application effect in the field of automatic driving, medical diagnosis. The results show that the adaptive deep learning algorithm can effectively process and analyze data from different sensors, achieving more comprehensive and accurate identification results, especially in applications such as autonomous driving and medical diagnostics.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment of Unexpected Events in Universities: Graph Theory Algorithms in Complex System Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: With the continuous development of society, the risk assessment of unexpected events in universities has become increasingly important. This study aims to explore the application of graph theory algorithms in complex system networks, in order to improve the accuracy and reliability of emergency risk assessment in universities. This article considers various related factors, including various interaction relationships within and outside the school, introduces graph theory algorithms, and identifies potential risk factors and vulnerabilities by analyzing the network structure and the relationships between nodes. This article found through empirical case studies that the average prediction accuracy of graph theory algorithms in the application of complex system networks can reach 93.34%, demonstrating the effectiveness of graph theory algorithms and providing new ideas and methods for risk management of unexpected events in universities.

articleTitle: Construction and Optimization of Secondary Management and Employment Service System for Vocational Colleges in Shaanxi Province Under Cloud Computing Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to explore the application and optimization effect of cloud computing platform in the secondary management and employment service system of vocal colleges in Shaanxi Province. Through the empirical research and case analysis of a vocal college, this paper discusses the construction of two-level management system and the optimization of employment service system. First of all, through the application of cloud computing platform, the integration of information systems of various departments within colleges and universities has been realized, and the efficiency of data sharing and management has been improved. Secondly, using the big data analysis and AI technology provided by the cloud computing platform, the intelligent support of the employment service system is realized, and personalized employment guidance and services are provided for students. The empirical research results show that the employment rate and salary level of graduates have been improved after the implementation of the scheme, and students' satisfaction with employment services has also been significantly improved. However, there are also some challenges and problems, such as data security and privacy protection, and further optimization of intelligent service functions. Future research will continue to deepen the application of cloud computing platform in the management and employment service of vocal colleges, so as to better promote the development of schools and the employment competitiveness of students.

articleTitle: Open Sharing and Cross-border Integration of Art Laboratory Resources Based on LLM and Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: The integration of local linear mapping (LLM) into art resource processing offers efficient extraction and classification of intricate art laboratory features, laying a data foundation for future resource sharing and cross-border integration. This article strives to enhance the precision and user satisfaction of art image feature recognition by presenting a 3D visualization algorithm that combines LLM with virtual reality (VR). Our ultimate goal is to foster the expansion of art education and resource sharing. Initially, we establish a 3D visualization model that leverages LLM and VR, enabling the extraction and showcase of nonlinear art image features for a more immersive and lifelike visual experience. Exhaustive experimental outcomes confirm that our algorithm and platform offer superior accuracy, richer artistic resources, and an elevated user experience in the realm of art education and resource sharing.

articleTitle: Application of Visualization and Interaction Technology in the Informationization Construction of Urban Rail Transit
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: Recently, urban rail transit (URT) has occupied a core position in urban transportation, effectively solving the problem of congestion caused by urban transportation. However, the problem of mismatch between passenger flow and transportation capacity has become increasingly prominent. In some time periods, transportation capacity waste is severe, and reducing transportation capacity waste requires a clear understanding of the distribution pattern of passenger flow throughout the day. Against the backdrop of the continuous advancement of information technology, smart cities have become the mainstream growth direction of urban construction, effectively changing the previous URT operation and management model. The construction of URT informatization has become an important way to solve traffic congestion, improve transportation efficiency, and optimize resource allocation. To improve the effectiveness of URT operation management and optimize the public’s travel experience, this article proposes a URT information construction system based on visualization and interaction technology. By using visualization technology to visually present URT’s operational data and scenarios, rapid information acquisition and interactive operations can be achieved. Using big data analysis techniques to process and analyze URT’s operational data, providing decision-makers with more accurate data and solutions. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this article can improve the operational efficiency and intelligence level of urban transportation.

articleTitle: Practice and Challenge of Interactive Intelligent Technology in Higher Education Quality Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, the application of interactive intelligent technology in the quality evaluation of higher education has gradually attracted widespread attention. This paper aims to explore the practical application of interactive intelligent technology in higher education quality evaluation and the challenges it faces. In practice, this paper introduces the application of intelligent evaluation methods such as fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model, and shows the advantages of these technologies in improving evaluation efficiency and enhancing evaluation accuracy through case analysis. However, it also faces a series of challenges in the application process, such as data privacy and security issues, technical costs and resource constraints, user acceptance and training needs. To overcome these challenges, this paper puts forward a series of suggestions, including strengthening data quality control, improving evaluation index system, and enhancing user friendliness. Through in-depth research and continuous improvement, interactive intelligent technology is expected to play a greater role in the evaluation of higher education quality and provide strong support for improving teaching quality.

articleTitle: Optimization of Image Compression and Decompression Performance Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: As one of the main carriers of information transmission and storage, image data need to be compressed in some application scenarios. Traditional image compression methods, although reducing the size of image files to a large extent, are still difficult to meet the performance requirements of massive, high-speed image data compression processing. In this paper, an image compression and decompression performance amelioration method based on genetic algorithm is proposed, aiming to ameliorate the efficiency and quality of image compression, while reducing the time and computational complexity of decompression. This paper first introduces the background and current status of image compression technology, and analyzes the progress of existing image compression research. Then, the basic principles of genetic algorithm and its application in image compression are introduced in detail. On this basis, an image compression algorithm based on genetic algorithm is proposed. The algorithm ameliorates the parameter settings in the image compression process through genetic algorithm to achieve efficient compression of images. At the same time, combined with the image decompression process, the decompression algorithm is ameliorated to reduce the consumption of computational resources. The research in this paper provides new ideas and methods for the performance amelioration of image compression and decompression technology, which has important theoretical and practical value.

articleTitle: Cultural Adaptation in Translation of Traditional Chinese Medicine Based on Self-adaptive Machine Translation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) is a traditional medical system in China, which has received increasing attention and application worldwide. However, the translation of TCM faces challenges brought about by cultural differences. Traditional machine translation methods often fail to accurately convey the cultural connotations and characteristics of TCM texts, leading to information loss and misunderstanding. To address this issue, a domain adaptive neural machine translation (NMT) adaptive method can be referred to. Firstly, by conducting in-depth analysis of the text in the source and target domains, domain features in the field of TCM can be identified and extracted. Secondly, an alignment relationship can be established between the source domain and the target domain to better adapt to the needs of TCM translation. Finally, the translation performance of the model in the field of TCM can be further improved through adversarial training and supervised domain adaptation. The experimental results show that the domain feature based NMT adaptive method has improved the BLEU (Bilingual Evaluation Understudy) score of TCM translation on domain specific datasets by at least 6.9% compared to the original data. It has been proven that this method can effectively translate while preserving cultural connotations and characteristics.

articleTitle: A Power IoT Terminal Asset Identification Technology Suitable for Modbus Protocol
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: In the new power system scenario, Power IoT terminals have new characteristics such as diverse hardware heterogeneity and complex subject ownership, which make it technically difficult to achieve secure access authentication based on traditional terminal hardware fingerprint recognition technology. A power IoT terminal fingerprint recognition technology suitable for the Modbus protocol is proposed to solve this problem. This method combines the characteristics of Modbus protocol packet parsing, which is a common industrial control communication protocol. Firstly, based on active packet detection technology, it realizes the survival judgment of business terminals and constructs a coarse-grained topology image of terminal production. Then, by passively monitoring and analyzing the characteristics of terminal interaction traffic behavior, a terminal behavior fingerprint recognition model is constructed based on the deep learning algorithm BiLSTM to achieve accurate terminal type discrimination, thereby establishing a power IoT terminal fingerprint recognition model. The experimental results in a distributed photovoltaic scenario show that the method has an average classification and recognition accuracy of 89.6% for common power business terminals, which can basically meet the lightweight and non-invasive business requirements of terminal fingerprint recognition in new power system scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on Keyword Selection and Search Engine Optimization Strategies for Online Marketing Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: Internet marketing has become an important means of promoting products and services for current enterprises. In the vast amount of online information, how to make their content stand out has become a major challenge for enterprises. Traditional keyword selection and SEO strategies often rely on manual experience and trial and error, which is less efficient and difficult to cope with the increasingly complex market environment. In this regard, keyword selection and SEO strategy development are particularly critical. The purpose of this paper is to investigate machine learning-based keyword selection and search engine optimization strategies for online marketing in order to improve the visibility and influence of companies in cyberspace. This paper first analyzes the limitations and shortcomings of traditional keyword selection methods, and then introduces the application of machine learning in keyword selection, including keyword extraction techniques based on text mining and natural language processing, and keyword prediction models based on user behavior analysis. Through machine learning algorithms, we are able to find the user's search intention and preference more accurately, so as to select keywords that are more in line with the needs of the target audience. This paper proposes SEO optimization strategies based on machine learning, including content optimization, website structure optimization, link building and other aspects. Through machine learning techniques, the evaluation criteria of search engines can be better understood and more scientific and effective SEO strategies can be developed.

articleTitle: Association Rule Mining in Urban Spatial Data Mining in Digital Twin Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of multi-source heterogeneity, inconsistent data formats, uneven data quality, and low efficiency in analysis and mining of urban spatial data (SD), association rule mining technology was introduced to establish a framework for urban SD mining, and an empirical analysis was conducted using S city as an example. The results showed that using association rule mining technology can improve the accuracy (Max: 95%) and integrity (Max: 95.4%) of urban SD, and the established urban SD mining framework can improve the efficiency of SD mining (Max: 89.5%). This study has provided a reference for the fusion application of multi-source heterogeneous data, new methods and ideas for digital twin modeling, and reference for the application of urban SD mining technology in urban governance.

articleTitle: Research on DGA Domain Name Detection Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: This study aims to investigate the detection of DGA domains based on machine learning techniques. Through in-depth understanding of the DGA domain generation algorithm and extensive data analysis, machine learning methods are used to effectively detect and identify DGA domains. By mining and analyzing various features, this study establishes an efficient classification model, and demonstrates the effectiveness and accuracy of the model through numerous experiments. The achievements of this research not only provide an effective means to detect DGA domains in the field of cybersecurity but also offer important references for addressing malicious software, network attacks, and information security issues.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment of Investment Decision-making in Construction of Electric Power Communication Network using Monte Carlo and Grey Relational Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: As an important part of the power system, the construction investment decision of the power communication network is of great significance to ensure the stable operation of the power system and to meet the increasing communication demand. However, the construction of power communication network involves many uncertain factors, such as technology update, market demand, policy changes, etc., which makes the investment decision face high risks. Therefore, it is crucial to conduct risk assessment for the investment decision of electric power communication network construction. In this paper, Monte Carlo simulation and gray correlation analysis are comprehensively used to assess the risk of investment decisions in electric power communication network construction. First, the probability distribution and probability characteristics of each risk factor are analyzed through Monte Carlo simulation; then, gray correlation analysis is used to determine the key risk factors and formulate risk countermeasures; finally, the results of the two methods are combined to provide a comprehensive evaluation and decision-making suggestions for electric power communication network construction investment decisions. The results of this paper are of great significance for improving the scientificity and accuracy of investment decision-making in electric power communication network construction, which helps to reduce investment risks, optimize resource allocation and improve the operational efficiency of the power system.

articleTitle: Deformation Prediction and Intelligent Monitoring Technology of Tunnel Engineering Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: Tunnel engineering plays an important role in modern urban construction and transportation, but the deformation of tunnel engineering poses a certain challenge to its safe operation. In order to improve the safety and reliability of tunnel engineering, this study discusses the deformation prediction and intelligent monitoring technology of tunnel engineering based on deep learning technology. In this study, a prediction model based on deep learning is designed, and the deep neural network is used to predict the deformation of tunnel engineering, and the accuracy and effectiveness of the model are verified by experiments. Then, the design and implementation scheme of intelligent monitoring system are put forward, and the real-time monitoring and early warning of tunnel engineering deformation are realized by combining sensor technology and data processing algorithm. Finally, the prediction effects of deep learning model and traditional monitoring methods are compared and analyzed, and the application prospect of deep learning technology in tunnel engineering is discussed. The research results show that the deformation prediction and intelligent monitoring technology of tunnel engineering based on deep learning has important theoretical and practical significance, and plays an important role in promoting the safety management and operation efficiency of tunnel engineering.

articleTitle: Application of Hybrid Cloud Architecture in the Design of Athletes’ Integrated Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: With the continuous development of information technology, the integrated management system of athletes plays an important role in improving the efficiency of athletes’ management, optimizing training programs and protecting athletes’ privacy. However, the traditional system design often faces the problems of high data storage cost, unstable performance and difficult security guarantee. In order to solve these problems, this study puts forward a scheme of applying hybrid cloud architecture to the design of athletes’ integrated management system, and verifies its effectiveness through case studies and empirical analysis. Firstly, by comparing the differences between traditional system and hybrid cloud architecture in system performance, flexibility and security, it is found that hybrid cloud architecture can optimize resource utilization and improve system flexibility and security. Secondly, the case study shows that the hybrid cloud architecture optimizes the resource utilization of the system and improves the performance and response speed of the system. The system has higher flexibility, and club managers can flexibly adjust the resource allocation in public and private clouds according to actual needs; The security of the system is improved. By encrypting, storing and transmitting sensitive data and implementing strict authority control mechanism, the personal information and training data of athletes are protected. To sum up, this study provides new ideas and methods for the design and practice of athletes’ integrated management system, and provides better user experience and management efficiency for club managers.

articleTitle: A Deep Network Representation Learning Model Constructed from English Teaching User Portraits
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: With the development of artificial intelligence technology and the rise of personalized education, building accurate English teaching user portraits has become the key to improving teaching quality and efficiency. This article aims to use deep network representation learning models to construct efficient English teaching user portraits. First, we introduced in detail the concept of English teaching user portraits and the basic principles of deep learning. Then, it focuses on the collection and preprocessing methods of user data, as well as the construction process of the deep network representation learning model based on autoencoders. Next, this paper conducts a comprehensive performance evaluation of the model through confusion matrices and ROC curves, and compares it with several other machine learning models. Finally, we summarize the main contributions and limitations of the study, and provide an outlook for future research directions. The research in this article not only provides a new user portrait construction method for English teaching, but also provides theoretical and practical support for the implementation of personalized education.

articleTitle: A Bi-LSTM Algorithm for Digital Library Information Resource Classification and Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: Information retrieval technology is one of the core technologies for information resource retrieval in digital libraries. The popularization of digital information resources provides a broader foundation for the classification and retrieval of information resources in digital libraries. Therefore, digital libraries need to adopt more advanced and efficient algorithms and search technologies to optimize users' retrieval experience and efficiency of information resources. There are some problems of today’s machine learning such as high mistaken rate, narrow training data and data bias. Therefore, this article aims to improve digital library information resource classification and retrieval by using Bi-LSTM algorithm. This algorithm can help model to adapt to a complicated collection of data more easily so that the model is trained more accurately. Thus, the overfitting problem and underfitting problem will be solved greatly by this algorithm. With the adaption of Bi-LSTM algorithm, the accuracy of digital library classification and retrieval is up to 97.5% so it is very promising to adapt Bi-LSTM algorithm to digital library information resource classification technology in the actual use.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Vision in Digital Development of Animation Design Teaching
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: Anime design is receiving increasing attention in today's society, and many people are interested in the creative and expressive techniques of anime imagery. However, traditional anime design teaching processes often rely on manual experience and judgment, making it difficult to meet students' needs for accurate identification and classification of anime images. By utilizing computer vision technology for fine-grained classification of anime images, more accurate and personalized teaching resources and tools can be provided to help students better understand and apply anime design techniques. This article analyzes the problem of intermediate layer fine-grained discriminative feature information loss when using bilinear convolutional neural networks for fine-grained image classification. The residual network is chosen to replace the two-route convolutional neural networks in the original B-CNN to improve the model's feature extraction ability. The different layer features extracted by the last three convolutional residual blocks of ResNet are separately subjected to bilinear pooling, and the resulting three feature vectors are processed and concatenated for multi-layer feature fusion. The interaction of multiple layer features enriches the learning of fine-grained features and reduces the problem of feature information loss in intermediate layers.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Information System for Online Class Platform Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: Nowadays, the era of intelligent education has come, the construction scale of online class platform is also expanding. Traditional educational resources and forms no longer meet today’s educational needs, with a single teaching method, low teaching efficiency, uneven development and a lack of guaranteed quality education in some areas. Cloud computing technology, as the future direction of network technology development, is a new opportunity for national development. Therefore, based on cloud computing technology, this paper researches and designs a comprehensive online class platform information system, which provides personal resource information, personalised recommendation, course resource acquisition and sharing, lesson preparation and test simulation and other functional modules, it realises the sharing of computer hardware resources, software resources, educational resources and other resources and interaction between teachers and students, scientifically and effectively solves the problems arising from the imbalance of educational resources, and meets the learning needs of teachers and students. At the same time, the system also improves the efficiency of the use of educational resources, greatly improves the quality of teaching and teaching effect, and is conducive to promoting the development of information technology of educational resources.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Deep Learning in Biomedical Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: With the rapid development of deep learning technology, its application in biomedical image processing has made significant progress. This article provides a comprehensive review of the application of deep learning in key biomedical fields such as medical image analysis, pathological image recognition, and cell imaging. Particular attention is paid to the application of convolutional neural networks (CNN) in image classification and segmentation, the role of recurrent neural networks (RNN) and its variants in sequence image data processing, and the application of generative adversarial networks (GAN) in high-quality biomedicine. potential in image generation. The integration and optimization of these deep learning models provides new methods and tools for accurate diagnosis, disease monitoring, and treatment. The article discusses how deep learning models can process and analyze large medical imaging datasets, and their potential applications in improving image analysis automation and accuracy.

articleTitle: University Student Management System Based on Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: Student management is very critical for colleges and universities. College student management departments need to adopt various means to manage students according to modern management theories and technologies. This paper first expounds the problems existing in the traditional student management system, and then proposes the design of the college student management system based on the deep learning algorithm. Specifically, this paper adopts deep learning algorithms such as artificial neural network and data mining technology to analyze, cluster and predict students’ data, which improves the data analysis ability and decision support ability of the system. Finally, this paper analyzes and evaluates the experiment, and the system response time, system security and data accuracy are 1.2s, 96% and 88% respectively, all of which are better than the traditional system. This system has good results and application prospects in student management and decision support. This paper provides a certain reference for the intelligent upgrade of the university student management system.

articleTitle: Discussion on Advertising Communication Effectiveness Detection Method based on Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: This article explores the intricacies of assessing the effectiveness of advertising communications using an advanced deep learning model, with a particular focus on predicting click-through rates. By highlighting the importance of online video advertising and its central role in shaping communication strategies, the study underscores the imperative for advertisers to achieve a satisfactory return on investment in the dynamic landscape of digital marketing. The proposed methodology introduces an innovative deep learning model that effectively addresses the challenges of parameter tuning and time-consuming training through the strategic incorporation of dropout technology and GPU acceleration. Rigorous experimental validation conducted on Avazu and Criteo datasets demonstrates the model's robustness and adaptability across a spectrum of advertising scenarios. The comprehensive literature review contributes nuanced insights into the intricacies of advertising effectiveness, providing a solid foundation for practical applications and future research efforts in the evolving field of online advertising. In summary, this research not only advances our understanding of advertising dynamics in the digital age, but also provides empirical support for the practical application of the model in real-world advertising contexts, providing the valuable insights for industry practitioners and researchers alike.

articleTitle: Design of Malicious Software Classification and Recognition Algorithms Based on Graph Theory in Computer Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: The rapid growth of the Internet has greatly improved the efficiency and convenience of social operation, but also brought about increasingly serious computer network security problems. With the rapid growth of Internet, mobile network and Internet of Things technology, a large number of malicious codes and their variants pour into cyberspace every day, posing a serious threat to network security. In this context, this article proposes a malicious software classification and recognition algorithm based on graph theory and deep learning (DL). The algorithm first collects and analyzes malicious software samples to construct a graph structure that can reflect the behavioral characteristics of the software. These graph structures not only contain static features of software behavior, but also incorporate temporal information during dynamic execution, thus enabling a more comprehensive characterization of the behavior patterns of malicious software. Next, the algorithm utilizes the DL model to learn and process the constructed graph structure, improving classification accuracy and efficiency by extracting deep level features of the graph. The experimental results show that the algorithm proposed in this paper has high classification accuracy and recognition rate, and can maintain good detection performance in different network environments and malicious software samples.

articleTitle: Practice and Challenges of a Personalized Education Resource Push System Driven by Big Data in Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: With the deep integration of big data and educational informatization, educational big data has gradually gained high support and recognition among educational institutions and users due to its advantages of low resource sharing difficulty, efficient centralized management, wide regional coverage, and massive practical educational resources. However, in the era of informatization, learning resources are growing exponentially, and learners face difficulties in selectivity and confusion when accessing resources. Traditional display feedback methods are no longer sufficient to meet their needs. To address this challenge, this article proposes a personalized education resource push system driven by big data. This system utilizes deep learning (DL) technology to deeply mine user needs and achieve personalized resource recommendations for learners. The experimental results indicate that the system can effectively improve the accuracy and efficiency of learners in accessing resources, providing strong support for personalized learning in higher education. The application of this system helps to enhance the learning experience and effectiveness of learners, and promotes the personalized and intelligent development of higher education.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Interactive Intelligent Technology for Action Judgment in Martial Arts Training
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to explore the application of interactive intelligent technology in the training of martial arts, and evaluate its potential to improve the training effect of martial arts. This paper designs and implements an action recognition model based on Deep learning (DL), which can accurately recognize the actions of martial arts in real time and provide immediate feedback.
