Compared with traditional methods, this study found that DL-based method showed significant advantages in accuracy, recognition speed and generalization ability. In addition, the stability of the proposed method in different scenarios and conditions is evaluated, and its generalization ability on different data sets is studied. The experimental results show that the motion recognition method based on DL has strong stability and generalization ability, and it is suitable for all kinds of complex training scenes of martial arts. These findings provide an important theoretical and practical basis for the application of interactive intelligence technology to martial arts training, and provide a more personalized and efficient auxiliary tool for martial arts training.

articleTitle: A State Evolution Prediction Model for Transmission Line Channels Based on Deep Learning (Point Cloud Data)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: The main objective of this study is to improve the accuracy and predictive performance of transmission line channel state evolution through the DL (Deep Learning) method, in order to improve the efficiency and reliability of power system management. In terms of methods, a brief introduction was given to the collection and preprocessing of data, including the integration of point cloud data, terrain data, and historical channel state data. Finally, the performance of the model was compared, and PointNet showed a gradually improving trend, with MAE (Mean Absolute Error) decreasing from approximately 0.11 to approximately 0.09. This indicates that the model gradually adapts to the dataset as training progresses. The MAE of 3D CNN fluctuates greatly, starting from about 0.76, experiencing ups and downs, and finally slightly rising to about 0.76. This may indicate that the model’s adaptability to training data is unstable. GCN (Graph Convolutional Network) starts at a lower MAE value of approximately 0.09 and shows a significant decrease during training, dropping to approximately 0.07 by the 10th cycle. This indicates that GCN has good initial adaptability for this task, and its performance significantly improves as training progresses.

articleTitle: A K-means Algorithm for Public Health Surveillance and Monitoring in Diabetes Prevention Sites
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: To ensure the health and safety of people with diabetes, public health surveillance and monitoring by diabetes prevention agencies have become critical. In today' s society, there is a serious error rate and missing rate in diabetes public health monitoring, which has a great impact on the health of patients. In this paper, K-means algorithm is used to monitor the on-site health status in real time, and the compliance rate of doctors and nurses is combined, and the conclusion is drawn through the experiment. The algorithm greatly reduces the error rate of diabetes field health monitoring and improves the accuracy rate up to 98.6%.

articleTitle: Construction of Personalized Practice Teaching Platform for School-Enterprise Integration Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: This study aims to use IGA (Improved Genetic Algorithm) to optimize the design and construction of a personalized practical teaching platform for school enterprise integration. This platform aims to meet the personalized learning needs of different students and effectively connect with the needs of enterprises. We first introduced the basic principles of genetic algorithms and their applications in optimization problems. Then, we described in detail the modeling of personalized practical teaching needs as a multi-objective optimization problem, including student satisfaction, education quality, enterprise needs, etc. Next, we proposed an application method for IGA to search for the optimal platform design. The experimental results show that the resource scheduling efficiency using IGA can more effectively meet the practical needs of students, with a resource scheduling efficiency of about 86%. Compared to traditional methods, the resource scheduling efficiency has reached 70%. IGA has improved resource utilization efficiency and increased student satisfaction. This indicates that IGA has potential in resource scheduling and schedule optimization in school enterprise integrated education, which can help provide a better learning experience. The results of this study are of great significance for promoting school enterprise cooperation, improving education quality, and cultivating graduates with practical skills.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Motor Control System Based on Matrix Theory
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: Based on the basic concept and classification of matrix and its application in the motor control design, in this paper, the mathematical model of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) and its significance to the control strategy design are discussed in detail. Highlighting the key role of matrix theory in judging the stability of the system, expounds the eigenvalue analysis and Lyapunov stability theory, and discusses the application of finite element methods such as numerical analysis (FEA) and linear matrix inequality (LMI) in stability analysis. By combining theoretical analysis, numerical methods and practical cases, the application value and wide applicability of matrix theory in motor control system design and stability analysis are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Construction of Art Virtual Simulation Laboratory Resource Sharing System Based on Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: Amidst the swift progress of modern science and technology, the implementation of data mining technology across various sectors has proven to be highly effective. This study aims to achieve resource sharing for the art virtual simulation laboratory by utilizing machine learning algorithms. By doing so, it intends to overcome challenges related to resource sharing in experimental teaching and the informatization of higher education, ultimately enhancing the utilization and efficiency of educational investments. Machine learning algorithms leverage artificial intelligence to train on extensive datasets, subsequently identifying operational parameters and models automatically. The virtual simulation experimental teaching demonstration center holds immense importance in experimental pedagogy and the digitization of higher education. Urgent attention is required to address effective resource sharing and utilization within this center, aiming to enhance the efficiency of educational investments. The emergence and progression of virtual simulation laboratories have added realism to scientific endeavors undertaken by college students in our country, offering advantages such as high utilization, ease of maintenance, and more. The machine learning algorithm employed in this study promises sophisticated computer development, surpassing the diagnostic accuracy of traditional BP neural network models, thereby achieving a higher diagnostic rate.

articleTitle: Construction of a Smart Mine Water Hazard Warning Platform Based on BIM+GIS 3D Visualization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: In response to the current situation of slow response speed and low warning accuracy of flood disaster warning systems, with the goal of improving the accuracy and real-time performance of flood disaster warning, this paper conducts research on a smart mining flood disaster warning system using visualization technology. This platform integrates BIM and GIS to achieve the integration, analysis, and visualization of multi-source data such as mine internal structure, geological features, and sensor data. By using real-time monitoring and analysis of mine data, combined with advanced warning algorithms and models, the platform can accurately identify potential water hazards and display them to users through 3D visualization. Experimental tests have found that the accuracy of early warning on this platform is between 93% and 98%. The construction of a smart mine water hazard early warning platform based on BIM+GIS 3D visualization has achieved significant results.

articleTitle: Construction and Probabilistic Analysis of the Observation Noise Model of the Earth's Deformation Based on Laplace Distribution
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: Observation of Earth's deformation plays a pivotal role in the analysis of Earth's tidal curves and the study of earthquake precursors, forming an integral part of Earth observation technology. Therefore, the anomaly detection and analysis of geodetic data are of paramount importance. This study primarily focuses on analyzing and modeling the geodetic data provided in the attachments. As part of the data preprocessing, a program was written in Python to read the data, revealing a significant number of missing values. These missing values were categorized into two types based on their location. To impute these missing values, we employed two techniques: spline interpolation and autoregressive prediction algorithms. Following the imputation process, a complete dataset was obtained. To isolate the noise components from the dataset, DB4 wavelet transform was utilized for noise reduction processing. The noise extracted from the data was then subjected to descriptive statistical analysis. A Laplace distribution was used to fit the probability distribution of the noise, resulting in an exact distribution of the noise within the data. Overall, this study demonstrates the utility of spline interpolation, autoregressive prediction, and DB4 wavelet transform in processing geodetic data and extracting noise. The Laplace distribution fitting provided an accurate representation of the noise distribution, offering valuable insights for the further enhancement of Earth's deformation observation techniques.

articleTitle: Construction and Optimization of An Intelligent Student Rating System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: Information technology has been widely applied in the area of education, and the analysis of big data can help optimize educational mechanisms to make more scientific decisions. With the continuous enhancement of intelligence level in universities, how to utilize massive teaching data and measure educational achievements and teaching processes through information technology has become a highly challenging research topic. The comprehensive quality evaluation of university students aims to improve the current evaluation ecology of university students, to achieve talent cultivation that not only meets the needs of social growth, but also meets the demands of comprehensive and personalized growth of students. The construction of an informationized and digitized comprehensive quality rating system can provide a more convenient way for the overall evaluation work and is of great significance for the reform of quality education in universities. This article constructs an intelligent student comprehensive quality rating system, which collects various data from students, uses big data analysis to intelligently evaluate their comprehensive quality, enhances the accuracy and efficiency of evaluation, and ultimately provides timely and accurate feedback to relevant personnel such as students, teachers, and parents. The experimental results indicate that the system designed in this article can accurately evaluate the comprehensive abilities of students.

articleTitle: Azimuth-only Passive Location of UAV Formation Based on Differential Evolution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the problem of azimuth-only passive positioning of UAVs in circular formation in order to avoid interference and maintain formation. Firstly, the polar coordinate system of the flying position of the formation is established. Secondly, the circular region is divided into four parts by analyzing the direction Angle, and the variable and its value range are determined. According to the geometric relationship, the positioning model of each region is established. In order to simplify the calculation, the differential evolution algorithm is used to solve the model, and the accuracy of the model is verified according to the known points.

articleTitle: Application and Practice of Interactive Visualization Technology in Online English Teaching
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid advancement and widespread usage of information technology have prompted China to extensively implement online teaching nationwide. However, a straightforward translation of traditional classroom methods to online formats frequently poses challenges in maintaining teaching quality. As a result, teaching interaction has emerged as a crucial determinant of online teaching’s effectiveness. The cornerstone of visual interactive teaching comprises four elements: an extensive collection of visual teaching materials, teacher-student engagement, courseware production techniques, and data interchange. To enhance the impact of online English teaching, this article introduces an interactive visualization technology-based online English teaching system. This system leverages the strengths of contemporary information technology to create rich and diverse visual teaching content, thereby fostering students’ interest and enthusiasm. Furthermore, it optimizes the interaction between teachers and students, strengthening communication and feedback, leading to more targeted and efficient teaching. Experimental outcomes reveal that this system not only boosts students’ academic performance and engagement but also contributes to enhancing teachers’ teaching efficiency and satisfaction.

articleTitle: Optimization of Optimal Risk Hedging Ratio Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: Futures and spot hedging strategy can eliminate the systematic risk of portfolio, determine the optimal risk hedging ratio between the two markets, and disperse the systematic risk to the greatest extent. The common methods to determine the optimal ratio are: least square method, bivariate vector autoregressive model, error correction model and ECM-GARCH model. This paper introduces a new method genetic algorithm and takes the hedging performance index he as the measurement standard. It is concluded that the actual risk hedging effect of genetic algorithm is the best. It should be noted that due to the uncertainty of genetic algorithm's evolution and screening process, the optimal hedging ratio may fluctuate within a limited range under certain fitness functions and feasibility constraints.

articleTitle: Modeling and Personalized Recommendation of Interest for Internet Users Using LDA
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: This article took network users as the research object, and studied the modeling of network user interests and personalized recommendation algorithms based on Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA). This method utilized the LDA model to extract implicit topic information from user behavior data, thereby establishing a user interest model. Based on this model, it studied a personalized recommendation algorithm based on user interests and topics. Experimental results have shown that the LDA model used in this article has significantly improved recommendation accuracy and novelty, with an average score of 95.1% and 92.9 points, respectively. The results indicate that the research findings of this project can help alleviate the problem of information overload, improve user experience, and achieve new breakthroughs in this field.

articleTitle: SNN Implementation Based on Systolic Arrays
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: As a neural network simulating the firing behavior of biological neurons, a spiking neural network (SNN) has the advantages of low power consumption, high efficiency and high fault tolerance, which is a vital way to realize brain-like computing. However, the implementation of SNN confronts many challenges, such as how to determine input coding, training methods and how to build network structure, hardware platform and so on. This paper presents an input coding scheme, network model and hardware implementation. The input coding scheme of SNN is based on Poisson coding, which can realize the transmission of information, effectively use time information, reduce redundant data, and improve the efficiency and robustness of coding. The network model is based on a three-layer network, consisting of an input layer, a hidden layer, and an output layer. The hardware implementation is based on Systolic arrays, which can realize large-scale parallel computing and improve the throughput and the speed of the hardware computing.

articleTitle: Debugging and Maintenance of the 15X Beam Type Coupler Buffer Device
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: The status of the 15X beam type Coupler buffer device directly determines the safety of train operation. Studying the standardized operation plan of the beam type Coupler buffer device, analyzing the common fault handling methods, can effectively ensure the quality of Coupler buffer device operation. This article introduces the structure of the 15X beam type Coupler buffer device, and based on this, designs a process plan for installation and debugging. It explains the main methods of daily maintenance and common troubleshooting methods.

articleTitle: Innovative Applications and Effect Evaluation of Artificial Intelligence in English Teaching
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology, its application in the field of education is becoming more and more extensive. This paper will explore the innovative application of artificial intelligence in English teaching and evaluate its effect. We have adopted the experimental research method, taking the students of Class 1 and Class 2, Grade 2 of School of Computer Science and Engineering, Guilin University of Technology as the research objects, receiving traditional teaching and artificial intelligence teaching respectively. The results of the study show that AI-assisted instruction significantly improves student achievement and interest compared to traditional instruction. In the final exam, the scores of the students in the experimental group were significantly improved, while the variance decreased, and the numbers of students in the 80-90 and above 90 range were significantly higher than that of the students in the control group. This study provides new ideas and methods for the field of English teaching, which is of great significance to promote educational innovation.

articleTitle: Automatic Correction Method for English Composition Errors Assisted by Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: As artificial intelligence (AI) continues to evolve, its applications in the realm of education are increasingly becoming prevalent. English composition (EC), a crucial language expression skill, serves as a vital medium for students to engage in input and output activities in their second language, garnering significant attention from educators and second language researchers. By harnessing AI to create an intelligent essay correction system, establish a personalized learning platform, and facilitate real-time interaction and communication, we can significantly enhance the efficiency and quality of English essay teaching, thereby fostering the comprehensive development of students. Drawing upon these principles, this article introduces an AI-assisted deep learning (DL) based EC error automatic correction system, encompassing a front-end learning unit and a back-end support unit. This system preprocesses collected EC fragments, extracts features using inter-segment distance partitioning factors, and employs dynamic time normalization techniques to correct and grade identified EC errors. The system then relays the recognition, correction, and scoring results to users through a feedback module. Simulation results demonstrate that the system described in this article effectively supports teachers in efficiently conducting essay corrections and data analysis, addresses the challenge of limited teacher correction and evaluation, boosts teaching efficiency, and spurs student initiative in writing.

articleTitle: Agricultural Financing Risk Data under Smart Contracts Based on LSTM-GRU Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: In response to the problems of low accuracy and slow decision-making efficiency in predicting agricultural financing risks, this paper combined smart contract technology and used the LSTM-GRU (Long Short Term Memory-Gated Recurrent Unit) model to analyze agricultural financing risk data. Firstly, data related to agricultural financing risks in 2022 and 2023 were collected on site, and principal component analysis was adopted for dimensionality reduction to accelerate decision-making efficiency. Then, the LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) model and GRU (Gated Recurrent Unit) model were fused, and agricultural financing risks were predicted. Finally, smart contracts were designed to apply the predicted results of the model to actual financing decisions. By monitoring the execution process of the contract, corresponding operations were executed based on the predicted results of the model. The experimental results showed that the average accuracy of the LSTM-GRU model in predicting agricultural financing risks reached 98.64%, which was 4.29% higher than the GRU model. The decision-making speed was only 0.52 seconds, which improved the prediction accuracy and decision-making efficiency of the model.

articleTitle: Research on Seasonal Power Balance Optimization of Power System Based on Intelligent Interactive Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: In this paper, the optimization of seasonal power balance in power system is studied, and an optimization model considering load characteristics and energy supply is proposed based on intelligent interaction technology. Firstly, the paper models the key links in the power system, including load forecasting, energy scheduling and intelligent decision-making. Then, by comprehensively considering the load characteristics and energy supply in different seasons, a multi-objective optimization model is constructed to realize the seasonal balance optimization of power system. In the experimental part, this paper verifies the effectiveness and practicability of the proposed model. The experimental results show that the proposed model can effectively improve the energy utilization rate of power system, reduce the operating cost, and maintain the stability and robustness of the system. The research results of this paper provide new ideas and methods for intelligent management and optimization of power system, and have certain theoretical and application value.

articleTitle: Research on Video Resource Recommendation of Higher Education Based on CNN-LFM Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: A new approach is proposed to enhance the accuracy of recommending higher education video resources using the CNN-LFM model. First, the scoring matrix and binary matrix of learner higher education video resources are constructed to calculate the learners’ interest in higher education video resources. Secondly, combining CNN model and LFM model, we calculate learners’ scores on unknown higher education video resources. Calculate the potential characteristics of higher education video resources according to the score calculation results. Finally, the objective function of higher education video resources recommendation is constructed after analyzing the computed potential features. The objective function can be solved to recommend the appropriate teaching resources. In comparison to conventional recommendation techniques, the experimental findings reveal a notable enhancement in recommendation accuracy with this method, achieving an impressive accuracy of up to 98%.

articleTitle: Reliable Image Enhancement Based on Evidence and Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: Deep learning have been widely applied in image enhancement, but traditional deep learning methods have not taken into account the uncertainty and reliability of image enhancement. We propose a new method of using generative adversarial networks to enhance image details, and introduce evidence theory to consider eliminating uncertainty during the training process of Generative Adversarial Networks. The simulation experiment on COVID-19 image data shows that the proposed method can supplement the details between high- quality images and low-quality images, improve the classification accuracy after image enhancement, and effectively increase the reliability of image enhancement.

articleTitle: Research on Interference Estimation and Tracking Control of Harmonic Reducer Based on Interference Observer
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: As an important part of industrial robot, the high-precision operation of harmonic reducer ensures the precise action of industrial robot, and its health directly determines the running accuracy and reliability of industrial robot. In order to solve the problems of complex and abrupt interference in industrial environment, this paper first constructs the dynamic model of harmonic reducer, and then carries out estimation research on mismatched nonlinear interference, and puts forward an improved interference observer to enhance the original observer structure robustly by sliding mode. Finally, based on interference estimation, a robust tracking control strategy based on sliding mode theory is designed to ensure that harmonic deceleration can accurately track control expectations under external interference. The simulation results show that the method proposed in this paper is able to estimate the nonlinear disturbance of harmonic reducer and realize tracking control accurately.

articleTitle: Research on Corpus-based Fuzzy Translation Techniques of English Translation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of English translation, this paper constructs a fuzzy translation model of English translation through corpus technology, and analyzes the fuzzy translation technology of English translation. According to the self-established Chinese-English parallel corpus of text, this paper quantitatively counts the fuzzy adjuncts, fuzzy concepts and fuzzy implication of fuzzy translation and their English translation, and qualitatively analyzes and discusses them with examples. On the basis of data training, the trained parameters are transferred to the encoding end and decoding end of the partially translated machine translation model to initialize the parameters at both ends, and the two-way machine translation model is obtained by adjusting the parameters at both ends through experiments. Then, this paper tests the effect of the model proposed in this paper through comparative experiments. Finally, the experimental results show that this method improves the correlation between automatic scoring and manual scoring in sentence-level translation quality estimation task, which is helpful to improve the accuracy of English translation.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Recommendation System for Professional Growth Path of English Teachers in Higher Vocational Colleges Under the Background of "Double High"
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: In the current education field, with the implementation of the "double high" policy, the professional growth of English teachers in higher vocational colleges(HVC) has become more important. In order to improve the teaching level and professional development of HVC English teachers, this study proposes a design and implementation method of professional growth path based on intelligent recommendation system. Firstly, by analyzing the professional growth needs and characteristics of HVC English teachers, the corresponding growth path model is established. Secondly, a recommendation algorithm based on deep learning is designed, and personalized development suggestions and resource recommendations are realized by analyzing the semantic matching between user queries and teaching resources. In the experiment, this study evaluates the proposed system with real data sets. The results show that the system performs well in accuracy and recall, and can improve user satisfaction and click-through rate. This study provides better support and guidance for the professional growth of HVC English teachers.

articleTitle: Research on the Improvement and Optimization of Smart Wearable Interactive Equipment for Track Training
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to explore the influence of the application of smart wearable interactive equipment in track training on training effect and athlete experience. Through the comparative study of experimental group(EG) and control group(CG) and the application of various statistical analysis methods, this study evaluates the effect of smart wearable devices in improving and optimizing track training. The results show that EG athletes show significant advantages in training effect score and physical fitness level improvement, and have higher training effect and better physical fitness level improvement compared with CG. In addition, the results of user satisfaction survey show that EG athletes have higher evaluation on the experience and function of smart wearable devices, while CG athletes have lower satisfaction. Correlation analysis further confirmed that there is a certain degree of positive correlation between the use frequency of smart wearable devices and the training effect, and the correlation between user satisfaction and the training effect. To sum up, smart wearable interactive devices have significant potential and value in track training, which can be used as an effective training aid and help to improve the training effect and experience of athletes.

articleTitle: Research on the Architecture Design Based on Large Language Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: This paper presents an architecture design tool based on the large language model, it achieves intelligent architecture design by understanding user intentions, and generating and optimizing designs. The architecture design tool is responsible for receiving user design inputs and displaying design results, while the large language model handles the task of intelligent architecture design. To enhance the large language model’s understanding of architecture design, a prompt learning method based on the chain of thought is used, enabling the large language model to have more potent reasoning abilities and interpretability. The LangChain framework integrates the large language model with third-party tools to apply architecture design knowledge. The large language model empowers the architecture design tool, providing intelligent, efficient, and reliable design support.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Spectral Selection and Multispectral Imaging Fusion Algorithm Based on Deep Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: Multispectral image fusion is one of the important tasks in the field of remote sensing. It aims to integrate information from different bands into a more informative feature representation, to better support tasks such as land classification, object detection, and environmental monitoring. In this article, we first introduce the background and importance of multispectral image fusion, and then introduce the basic concepts of DL (Deep Learning) and DNN (Deep Neural Network) to explain why DL has potential in multispectral image fusion. Next, we discussed in detail the design and architecture of the CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) model, including components such as convolutional layers, pooling layers, and fully connected layers. We described how to effectively process multispectral data in CNN and extract band specific feature representations. Finally, through a series of experiments, we validated the effectiveness of the proposed method and quantified the effectiveness of different methods by comparing performance evaluation indicators. These research results provide valuable contributions to the application and research of remote sensing science, and provide new directions and methods for the further development of multispectral image fusion.

articleTitle: Strategies for Graph Optimization in Deep Learning Compilers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: This manuscript presents an exhaustive survey of graph optimization strategies in the realm of deep learning compilers, elucidating the pivotal evolution of artificial intelligence compilers. These compilers play an integral role in harmonizing software and hardware capabilities to enhance the efficiency of deep learning processes. The paper meticulously delves into a variety of front-end optimization techniques. These techniques are instrumental in refining the structure of computational graphs, thereby significantly bolstering the efficiency of neural network training and inference phases. Additionally, the paper highlights the escalating demands in computational performance, memory requirements, and hardware synchronization in the context of deep learning, outlining fertile avenues for future research. It underscores the complexity of managing increased computational loads and the intricate interplay between various hardware components. The discussion extends to the challenges and potential strategies for optimizing resource allocation and data flow within these systems.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence-based Exploration of Piano Playing Skills and Human Finger Function Health
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: As artificial intelligence (AI) technology continues to evolve, its applications in music are steadily growing. However, research focusing on piano performance skills and finger health remains limited. Against this backdrop, our article introduces an AI-driven approach for assessing piano performance skills while delving deeper into finger function health. Initially, we've developed a multi-faceted evaluation system for piano proficiency, leveraging AI for automatic processing and analysis of performance data. Concurrently, we've examined the impact of piano playing on finger function by gathering data on finger movements and force exertion. To validate our approach, we conducted experiments involving piano players of varying skill levels. The collected data encompassed their performance metrics as well as finger function metrics. The findings reveal that our AI-based assessment method accurately differentiates players based on their skill level, aligning closely with manual assessments to achieve a remarkable similarity of over 97.8%. Furthermore, our study underscores the potential risks of prolonged and intense piano practice on finger health, specifically muscle fatigue and injury. We emphasize the importance of balanced practice routines and targeted finger exercises in mitigating these risks.

articleTitle: Application of Improved Association Rule Algorithm in Higher Education Teaching Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: Data mining is an innovative approach to data analysis that sifts through vast quantities of data stored in the digital realm in search of useful information. One data mining methodology called association rule mining uses computational methods to discover numerous related rules in massive datasets. This paper presents the creation of an information-based teaching management system that incorporates association rule mining techniques to improve the level and efficiency of university teaching management. Each system relies on its client, server, and database. The server runs the system program logically, while the client handles user interaction. In order to get educational data pertaining to users, the system builds a database that includes all the necessary information about teaching management and uses better association rule mining algorithms. Teaching, course selection, and course services are all made available to users through the client interface. The performance of the system is tested using a university information platform. The results show that the system can achieve course query functionality and has good client compatibility. It can be applied in various browsers and operating systems, demonstrating strong applicability and excellent data mining performance.

articleTitle: Inversion of Plant Carotenoid Content Using a Combined Model of Radiative Transfer Model and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: The rapid and accurate quantitative assessment of carotenoid content plays a crucial role in monitoring changes in vegetation growth and aging characteristics of plants. Due to the complexity of radiative transfer models and the non-linear relationship between vegetation spectra and carotenoid content, coupled with the presence of numerous uncertainties in the surface environmental system, traditional radiative transfer model inversion techniques can no longer meet the need for precise estimation of vegetation carotenoid content. Machine learning algorithms can express implicit and potential non-linear functional relationships between plant biochemical parameters and spectral reflectance, making machine learning potentially more suitable for retrieving vegetation biochemical parameters through radiation transfer model inversion. This study will select vegetation indices sensitive to carotenoid content through polynomial fitting, and then construct inversion models to predict carotenoid content information using a combined model of Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM) and PROSPECT-5. Finally, the accuracy of these inversion models will be validated using LOPEX93 data. The results show that the combined model has good predictive capability, and the accuracy of carotenoid content predictions is high, providing strong support for the application of gradient boosting machine in the inversion of vegetation parameters.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Traffic Prediction and Congestion Control Algorithms in Software Defined Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: With the rise of Software Defined Networking (SDN) and the tremendous success of Machine Learning (ML) methods in classification, prediction, and control tasks, finding new traffic engineering techniques to adaptively and dynamically manage or route traffic in networks, ensuring service quality, and improving user experience quality has become a hot research topic in network research. SDN is a new type of network architecture with enormous growth potential. Its core idea is to separate forwarding and control, and concentrate intelligence on the controller for centralized control. This paper proposes an ML based traffic prediction and congestion control algorithm to address the problem of uneven load on the control plane of SDN architecture due to the complexity and variability of network traffic. Historical traffic data is collected from the SDN controller and feature extraction is performed. The extracted features are used to train the ML model and predict future traffic. Based on predicted traffic information and perceived congestion, the controller can dynamically adjust network parameters to avoid or alleviate congestion. The experimental results show that the algorithm proposed in this paper can achieve more efficient network traffic management and congestion control in SDN, thereby improving network performance and user experience.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction and Governance Mechanism of Supply Chain Platform Ecosystem in Digital Economy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: With the rapid development of the digital economy, the supply chain platform ecosystem plays an important role in it. Therefore, building and effectively governing the supply chain platform ecosystem is crucial for improving supply chain management efficiency and promoting the development of the digital economy. This article studies the construction and governance mechanism of the supply chain platform ecosystem. Firstly, the definition and characteristics of the supply chain platform ecosystem were analyzed. Secondly, the key elements and challenges faced in building and governing the supply chain platform ecosystem were proposed. Next, the design principles and framework of the supply chain platform ecosystem were discussed. Finally, the governance mechanism of the supply chain platform ecosystem was discussed, including the roles and responsibilities of participating entities, information sharing, and collaborative innovation mechanisms. This study is of great significance for promoting the efficiency of supply chain management and the development of the digital economy.

articleTitle: Network Operation and Maintenance Technology Based on Machine Learning Algorithms in Cloud Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: The rapid growth of cloud computing is profoundly changing the face of information technology, leading it to new heights of specialization, intelligence, and intensification. Driven by cloud computing, the connections between multiple information technology industry chains are becoming increasingly close, and the aggregation effect of resources is becoming more prominent. Collaborative work and information sharing are further promoted, providing new ideas for entering the service-oriented computing era. With the continuous growth and popularization of cloud computing technology, its application in the field of network operation and maintenance is becoming increasingly widespread, becoming an important force in promoting the intelligence and automation of network operation and maintenance. Machine learning (ML) algorithm, as an important branch of artificial intelligence (AI), provides a new solution for network operation and maintenance with its powerful data processing and pattern recognition capabilities. This article proposes a network operation and maintenance system based on ML algorithm, which fully utilizes the resource advantages of cloud computing environment and the intelligent analysis ability of ML algorithm to achieve real-time monitoring, fault prediction, and automated processing of network status. The experimental results show that the system can significantly improve the efficiency and accuracy of network operation and maintenance, reduce operation and maintenance costs, and provide strong support for enterprise information construction.

articleTitle: A Method for Identifying High-Consequence Areas of Gas Pipelines Based on Improved U-Net
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: Efficient and accurate identification of high-consequence areas around pipelines is crucial for pipeline safety management. To address the challenge of efficiently extracting building contours using existing semantic segmentation models, this paper proposes a semantic segmentation model called UNetCBAMBR, which is based on an improved UNet architecture. The ESFNet, FPN, UNet, and UNetCBAMBR models were trained on the publicly available WHU dataset. The training results demonstrate that the improved model achieves the best performance in building segmentation with more complete edge extraction, reaching PA and MIOU scores of 96.57% and 84.56%, respectively. Finally, a case study is conducted on a pipeline in a specific area using the proposed improved model for building extraction and high-consequence area pipeline identification.

articleTitle: The Application of Interactive AI-Based Narrative Translation Model in Fashion Design
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: The role of the fashion design industry has become increasingly prominent, and has gradually become an important means of urban economic and social development, accelerating the transformation and upgrading of urban industry, and enhancing the cultural heritage of the city. This paper constructs a narrative translation model based on interactive AI (Artificial Intelligence), constructs a natural language generation module, and enables the model to generate text content in line with the fashion design situation in real time according to the designer’s input, and provides a human-machine interface for the designer to interact with the artificial intelligence assistant. This paper compares the time required for designers to complete the design task before and after using the model, and evaluates whether the model improves the design efficiency. The designer numbered 2 (Flyer design) has a completion score of 65% before using the model, 85% after using the model, 3.5 hours before using the model, 2 hours after using the model, and a designer satisfaction score of 9 points. This paper will help promote the progress of fashion design industry and shorten the time of fashion design.

articleTitle: Application of Generative Artificial Intelligence Technology in Customized Learning Path Design: A New Strategy for Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: In today's rapidly evolving education field, generative artificial intelligence (AI) technology is increasingly becoming a key force in promoting teaching innovation and personalized learning solutions. This article deeply explores the application of generative AI technology in designing customized learning paths in higher education and its profound impact on educational practice. Through specific case analysis, this study reveals how generative AI can effectively analyze students' learning behaviors, preferences, and performance to automatically generate and adjust learning paths in real time, thereby providing students with a highly personalized learning experience. Research results show that using generative AI technology can significantly improve learning efficiency, increase student engagement and satisfaction, and optimize learning outcomes. In addition, this article also demonstrates the ability of generative AI to promote innovation in learning content and teaching methods, improve the efficiency of educational resource utilization, and enhance the adaptability of learning paths. Through these findings, this paper provides valuable insights for higher education institutions, pointing out the importance and feasibility of leveraging generative AI technologies to design personalized learning paths, while highlighting key considerations that should be noted during implementation.

articleTitle: Wheelbase-weighted Path Planning Algorithm in Regular Grid Digital Elevation Map
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: In order to deal with the low efficiency of the RRT algorithm in digital elevation model (DEM) path planning, we propose an improved wheelbase-weighted RRT algorithm. This algorithm fully considers the motion wheelbase information of the machine or vehicle, uses the three-dimensional wheelbase as the connection between the starting point and the target, and guides the growth of the tree by weighting the wheelbase of the sampling points as each node expands. Simulation results show that this improved method can comprehensively consider factors such as distance, elevation, and slope when planning paths, improving the feasibility of the path. Compared with traditional methods, the improved algorithm significantly reduces the search time, improves the overall algorithm efficiency, and provides useful exploration for performance optimization in the field of digital elevation model path planning. This research provides a more flexible and intelligent solution to path planning problems in practical applications.

articleTitle: Variational Autoencoder Based Distributed Unsupervised Meta-learning Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: Unsupervised meta-learning exhibits broader applicability in practical scenarios, significantly reducing the reliance on abundant labelled data. However, the majority of current methods are centralized and not suitable for distributed scenarios. This paper centers on the issue of distributed unsupervised meta-learning and proposes a framework for distributed unsupervised meta-learning (DUML) that is founded on the Variational Autoencoder (VAE) and a fusion strategy. Each agent optimizes the variational parameters on local data and fuses its neighboring parameters to acquire a global variational model. Simulations on the Omniglot dataset visually demonstrate that DUML framework is capable of matching the performance of the corresponding centralized framework and surpassing non-cooperative framework.

articleTitle: Research on Price Prediction of Used Books on Online Platform Based on Grey Correlation Analysis and BP Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: This study is based on 704 data from the second-hand book platform of Kongfuzi Used Books, and empirically analysed for the first time using a BP neural network model. The main purpose of the study is to determine the influence prediction indexes by comprehensively considering the four aspects of used books: their own characteristics, publication-related factors, content attributes, and price elements. In order to deeply understand the correlation between these factors, we adopted the grey correlation analysis method and constructed a grey correlation matrix. Through this matrix, we obtained a grey composite correlation score, and the results showed that the quality, binding, open edition, number of pages, pricing, subject category to which the book belongs, publication time, and edition of used books have a significant impact on the price of used books. Specifically, our study points to a number of factors that contribute to the price formation of second-hand books, among which the factors of quality, binding, size, number of pages, pricing, the book's academic discipline, the time of publication, and the number of editions have been shown to have a significant impact on the price. This comprehensive consideration helps to grasp the price formation mechanism of the second-hand book market more comprehensively. In order to further improve the prediction accuracy of the model, we introduce a BP neural network model for price prediction. The results show that the used book price prediction model we constructed has a goodness-of-fit of 96.37%, indicating that the model performs well in explaining price changes. This high goodness-of-fit provides us with new insights into pricing models for used book platforms and provides a strong reference for future used book price prediction research. This not only provides academics with insights into the used book market, but also provides strong support for price setting in actual business operations.

articleTitle: Enhanced English Learning through Integrated Interactive Systems and Deep Learning Utilizing Digital Resources
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to explore the effect of the integration of interactive systems and deep learning (DL) on English learning utilizing digital resources. This paper adopts a comparative analysis method within the experimental group (EG) and its control group (CG). Through a comparative study of EG students’ use of interactive systems and DL integrated English learning platform, and CG students’ use of traditional learning methods, the influence of the fusion mode is evaluated on the basis of the learning effect and learning efficiency. The experimental results indicated that the interactive systems and DL integrated learning platform can provide personalized path of learning, real-time feedback and multi-modal learning experience, which significantly improve students’ learning interest and outcomes. Although EG students spend less engaged time per week on average, their learning efficiency turns out higher than CG students, with their academic performance improved accordingly. The findings demonstrate that the integration of interactive systems and DL plays a positive role in promoting English learning under the condition that digital resources are sufficiently utilized, and thus offer new perspectives and methods for the enhancement and innovation within the arena of English language education.

articleTitle: Studies on Deep Reinforcement Learning-based Recognition Techniques and Models for Global Information Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: This research is dedicated to achieving real-time collection of global security information by adopting an innovative methodology for generating time-rich data through real-time recognition of sounds that may appear at any time. This technical solution not only provides an efficient means for global security monitoring, but also achieves real-time monitoring of a wide and diverse range of security events without relying on traditional data sources with the help of sound recognition technology. In the process of real-time collection of global security information, the sound recognition technology used gives full play to its superiority. Through real-time recognition of sounds that may occur at any time, the system is able to quickly capture potential security event clues, which not only strengthens the response speed to emergencies, but also effectively reduces the reliance on traditional data sources. This approach is remarkably practical and highly adaptable when dealing with global security issues. By incorporating voice recognition technology, the technical solution proposed in this study ushers in an innovative development in the field of global security monitoring. Not only does it enable timely identification of and response to a wide range of security events, but it also provides a more flexible and efficient method for realising the monitoring of a wide range of security issues. The results of this research provide a new technological path for real-time monitoring and response in the field of global security, which has important theoretical and practical value.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Interactive Visualization Platform in English Teaching
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: This study aims to explore the design and application of interactive visualization platform in English teaching, so as to improve students’ learning effect and learning experience. By constructing an interactive visualization platform, combining modern educational technology and English teaching theory, the dynamic presentation of English learning content, the setting of personalized learning tasks and the interactive communication between students are realized. In the research, Experimental group (EG) and control group (CG) are adopted in this paper, and the learning effect and experience of using interactive visualization platform and traditional teaching methods are compared. The results show that EG students’ English scores are significantly higher than CG’s, and their learning motivation and learning satisfaction are also significantly improved. In addition, EG students are more active in the learning experience of interactive visualization platform and participate in the learning process more actively. This shows that the interactive visualization platform plays a significant role in promoting English teaching, which can improve students’ learning effect, stimulate their interest in learning and enhance their learning satisfaction.

articleTitle: Analysis of Physical Education Curriculum Reform Strategies Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: As a key link in the education system, physical education (PE) curriculum reform and innovation have also received extensive attention. This article aims to explore the reform strategy of PE curriculum based on machine learning (ML) to improve students’ sports skills and health level. To achieve this goal, we introduce collaborative filtering (CF) algorithm to make individualized recommendations for PE courses. By collecting and analyzing students’ historical data, sports preferences and physical fitness, this study constructs an effective recommendation model. The results show that the model can accurately identify students’ needs and recommend suitable PE courses for them, thus significantly improving students’ participation and satisfaction. Compared with the traditional PE curriculum model, the reform strategy proposed in this article is more intelligent and individualized, which is helpful to cultivate students’ innovative spirit and practical ability. To sum up, the reform strategy of PE curriculum based on ML has a wide application prospect in the field of education, which is expected to inject new vitality into future PE.

articleTitle: Exploration of the Integration of Virtual Simulation and Visualization Technology in Interactive Landscape Design
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology, it is difficult for traditional landscape design methods to fully show the interactivity and practical effect of design schemes. Therefore, by integrating data platform, optimizing interface design and improving rendering algorithm, this study realized the deep integration of virtual simulation and visualization technology in interactive landscape design. This fusion method not only improves the design efficiency and optimizes the design effect, but also significantly enhances the interactive experience of users. In the aspect of data integration and sharing, this paper constructs a unified data platform, realizes the data exchange between virtual simulation and visualization technology, and ensures the accuracy and consistency of data. In the aspect of interface integration, this paper designs a friendly human-computer interaction interface, which supports a variety of input devices and interaction methods and improves the user experience. In addition, an efficient rendering algorithm is proposed in this study, which is based on ray tracing technology and has been optimized to improve the fidelity of the scene and the real-time response ability of the system. This paper takes an interactive landscape design project of a city park as an example, and realizes the technical realization path of virtual simulation and visualization technology through tools such as Unity3D and Tableau. Constructing 3D model database, realizing dynamic interactive function and integrating multi-source data for visual display have successfully provided a novel and intuitive display method for urban park interactive landscape design projects. This will not only help designers better understand and optimize the design scheme, but also improve public participation and satisfaction.

articleTitle: YOLO Algorithm in Analysis and Design of Athletes’ Actions in College Physical Education
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: This article designs an action analysis system based on the YOLO (You Only Look Once) algorithm, which can collect video information through sensors and perform feature extraction. Based on the extracted feature extraction model, this paper uses the YOLO algorithm to detect and recognize moving targets in videos, and converts the recognition results into corresponding labels. These labels can be fed back to the trained YOLO model to analyze actions. The results indicate that the action analysis based on YOLO algorithm studied in the article can effectively improve the fluency and safety of students’ actions.

articleTitle: Research on User Experience Optimization of Intelligent Virtual Assistant Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: The optimization of user experience for intelligent virtual assistants is currently a hot research area. This article provides a thorough analysis from multiple dimensions and proposes several user experience evaluation and optimization methods based on deep learning. These methods effectively model user experience, optimize dialogue management. To address the challenge of insufficient data, the article employs algorithms such as transfer learning and online learning for data augmentation, and improves the personalized experience of virtual assistants through a user feedback loop mechanism. Additionally, the article presents a system implementation framework and a user experience evaluation index system. Finally, the article discusses the possibilities of applying virtual assistants to various fields such as online education, healthcare, and smart homes. Overall, the article comprehensively enhances the user experience of virtual assistants through deep learning, and the constructed method framework demonstrates strong scalability.

articleTitle: Design of Public English Flip Classroom Teaching Model Based on Fuzzy Control Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: In this study, the fuzzy control algorithm is integrated into the flip classroom teaching model to assess its effectiveness in enhancing public English flip classrooms. Through a combination of quantitative and qualitative analyses, an empirical investigation of public English courses at a university was conducted. Two comparable classes were selected as the experimental and control groups, respectively, to systematically gather data on students’ learning progress. The findings were then analyzed using statistical and content analysis methods. The results indicate that the flip classroom model, supported by the fuzzy control algorithm, offers distinct advantages in improving students’ English proficiency, increasing their engagement in learning, and facilitating personalized instruction. Notably, the students in the experimental group achieved significantly higher average scores in the final examination compared to those in the control group. Additionally, their attitudes towards learning and their ability for independent learning showed marked improvement. These findings highlight the crucial role of the fuzzy control algorithm in refining and optimizing teaching strategies, demonstrating the practical value of this model in public English education.

articleTitle: Monitoring Surface Deformation of Transmission Channel by Using High Resolution InSAR Data in Time Series
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to deeply explore the characteristics of surface deformation around transmission channels by using the time series data of high-resolution Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar (InSAR) technology. Taking Pearl River Delta (PRD) as the research object, through processing and analyzing the high-resolution SAR data provided by TerraSAR-X and Sentinel satellites, we have comprehensively monitored the ground deformation around the transmission channel. In the data preprocessing stage, radiation calibration, terrain correction and multi-view geometric registration are adopted to ensure the accuracy of the original data. Through phase analysis, the surface deformation interferogram around the transmission channel is generated, which shows the spatial distribution of surface subsidence and uplift. Time series analysis reveals the dynamic process of surface deformation. We have observed many factors of deformation, including geological factors, human activities and meteorological factors. Through the trend and periodicity analysis of time series, it provides a profound understanding of deformation change. High-resolution InSAR technology shows obvious advantages in the research, and its spatial resolution and temporal resolution enable us to understand the dynamic changes of the surface around the transmission channel more comprehensively and in detail. This brings new challenges and opportunities to the safety management and preventive maintenance of power system. This study provides an empirical study for the application of high-resolution InSAR technology in surface deformation monitoring of transmission channels. Our conclusion not only emphasizes the importance of this technology in power system security assessment, but also provides new directions and ideas for future related research.

articleTitle: Construction and Application of Corpora in Computer-Assisted Translation of Spanish Intangible Cultural Heritage for External Promotion
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: As an important carrier of China's outstanding traditional culture, Guangdong's intangible cultural heritage embodies unique and rich connotations. Showcasing its charm to the world helps promote international cultural exchange and understanding, but language barriers have long hindered its dissemination abroad. To address this, this study aims to construct a corpus for Spanish translation of Guangdong intangible cultural heritage promotion materials, and train a domain-adaptive neural machine translation model based on this corpus to break through language barriers and facilitate the international dissemination of China's intangible cultural heritage.

articleTitle: Research on LSTM Haze Prediction Model Based on Pearson Feature Selection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: The formation process of PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</inf> is intricate, posing challenges to haze forecasting. To delve into data correlations and enhance algorithm performance, we devised an LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory Neural Network) air quality prediction model employing Pearson feature selection. Initially, the Pearson correlation coefficient filtered the dataset, followed by the application of a parameter-optimized LSTM model to predict PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</inf> concentration. Experimental findings demonstrate that the model, built on the filtered dataset, effectively predicts PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</inf> concentration with consistent accuracy and markedly reduced computation time. This approach offers a promising method for urban haze pollution prediction.

articleTitle: Practice and Exploration of Multidimensional Resource Scheduling and Optimization in Cloud Computing Big Data Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: In the cloud computing big data environment, multi-dimensional resource scheduling and optimization play a crucial role. The dynamic resource supply based on virtual technology is one of the core features of cloud computing systems, and its "Pay as you go" service model brings flexibility and efficiency to users. However, facing challenges such as dynamic load characteristics, uneven resource utilization, and reliable workflow tasks, ensuring effective resource utilization and reliable task execution has become an urgent task. In response to the instability caused by dynamic load changes, this paper proposes a decomposition synthesis load prediction algorithm with error compensation. This algorithm uses statistical analysis and Kalman filtering techniques to decompose dynamic and complex host loads into simple task loads, and predicts and corrects them, thereby reducing the impact of uncertainty on scheduling and improving resource utilization efficiency. Secondly, in response to the imbalance of resource utilization, this article introduces a multidimensional resource scheduling mechanism that combines virtual machines and containers. This article provides an in-depth analysis of the dynamic characteristics of cloud environments and proposes corresponding solutions to address the challenges, demonstrating good results and providing useful references for the practice and exploration of multi-dimensional resource scheduling and optimization in cloud computing big data environments.

articleTitle: Adaptive Education Platform Based on Machine Learning: A New Way to Improve the Quality of Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: The aim of this research is to investigate the efficacy of an adaptive educational platform utilizing machine learning in enhancing the quality of higher education, validated through empirical analysis. By assessing individualized learning requirements and behavioral patterns of students, the platform offers tailored learning paths and resource recommendations to enhance learning outcomes and satisfaction. Employing an experimental control group design, the study compares teaching methodologies between the experimental and control groups. Findings indicate significant improvements in academic performance, satisfaction, and learning behavior among students in the experimental group, highlighting the effectiveness of the machine learning-based adaptive educational platform in elevating higher education quality and offering novel avenues for educational enhancement and innovation. This study holds crucial theoretical and practical implications for advancing educational technology and enhancing educational quality.

articleTitle: Indoor Localization via Deep Learning with Self-Attention and Stacked Denoising Autoencoders
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: Although GPS excels in outdoor navigation, its indoor localization capabilities are inadequate. This study presents an indoor positioning model designed for complex, multi-level environments, utilizing Stacked Denoising Autoencoders (SDAE), attention mechanisms, and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). SDAE enhances data quality and feature extraction, attention mechanisms focus on key localization features, and CNN processes spatial aspects of WiFi fingerprint data. Evaluated with the UJIIndoorLoc dataset, our model achieved an accuracy of above 99% in detecting buildings and floors, with a mean localization error of 6.41 meters, proving its effectiveness in indoor contexts.

articleTitle: Research on Prediction Technology of Table Tennis Landing Point Based on Multi-scale Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: This study is devoted to improving the accuracy and robustness of table tennis impact prediction through multi-scale image processing technology. By using high-resolution camera to capture the scene of table tennis match, a multi-scale image processing model based on Gaussian pyramid is constructed in this study, aiming at capturing the characteristics of table tennis more comprehensively and carefully. During the experiment, firstly, the image is Gaussian filtered and downsampled to construct a multi-layer pyramid, so as to obtain the image representation at different scales. Then, local features at different scales are extracted by local binary pattern (LBP) and directional gradient histogram (HOG) to form multi-scale feature representation. An end-to-end prediction model of table tennis impact point is constructed by fusing features at different scales. Comparative experiments show that the model based on multi-scale image processing shows better performance in different scenes and lighting conditions compared with traditional methods. The accuracy of the model is significantly improved, especially in the situation of dealing with high-speed movement and complex spatial structure. It is also found that the reasonable adjustment of the scale selection plays a key role in the performance of the model, so that it can achieve excellent prediction results in different table tennis stadiums. The results of this research not only have a positive application prospect in the field of table tennis, but also have certain guiding significance for the development of image processing and prediction technology in sports.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Rail Transit Hub Interchanges Based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: With the continuous development of urbanization, high-quality and efficient transportation modes have become the main demand of people to travel, which also requires the city to continuously optimize the regional rail transit hub. With the increase of passenger flow pressure in the rail transit hub, passenger flow optimization has become an important research content in the transportation department. This paper makes a comprehensive evaluation of rail transit hub transfer through literature investigation and empirical analysis. Through the literature survey, the important research theory of the AHP method is obtained based on the most advanced research literature, which plays an important role in the comprehensive evaluation. By combining computer technology demonstrates the adaptability of computer technology in the design of rail transit hub. Through the empirical analysis method, this paper obtains the calculated value, which can analyze and judge the evaluation level of the hub, and proposes the optimization scheme. Through the AHP algorithm, this paper establishes the transfer index and weight of the rail transit hub. Finally, this paper empirically analyzes the transfer results of the rail transit hub under this weight. The results show that AHP method can effectively shorten the transfer time of regional rail transit and continuously optimize the transportation capacity of transportation hubs.

articleTitle: Performance Optimization of Intelligent Operation and Inspection System in Computer Room Assisted by MR Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: If a device in the equipment room is faulty, you need to quickly locate the fault and take corresponding measures. However, due to complex interactions between devices, failures can involve multiple parties, making location and handling difficult. Traditional O&M training often relies on text and pictures, which makes it difficult for O&M personnel to intuitively understand the equipment room and equipment. MR Technology can build a realistic virtual environment of the machine room, so that operation and maintenance personnel can carry out practical operations in the virtual environment, and improve the training effect. Therefore, with the help of MR Technology, this study optimizes the performance of the intelligent operation and inspection system in the computer room. The hardware design of the system is completed by data acquisition terminal and data processing industrial computer. On this basis, the intelligent operation and inspection MR Model of the computer room is constructed, the abnormal operation and inspection of the computer room is completed based on convolutional neural network, and the three-dimensional visualization module is constructed based on MR Technology. The experimental results show that: The optimized system has higher visual display frame rate and lower failure rate after operation and inspection. When the number of iterations is 60, the fitness of the proposed system reaches 945 and the convergence performance is better.

Author Keywords: intelligent operation and inspection of machine room

articleTitle: A Study on Video Classification Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: This research delves into the application of deep learning methodologies for video classification, with a specific focus on sports action recognition. Utilizing the A1 sports action dataset, the study partitions the data into 75% for training and 25% for testing, aiming to assess the efficacy of a novel proposed method against existing classification techniques.
