These techniques range from traditional handcrafted feature approaches to advanced deep learning models, including SGSH, snippets, and two-stream LSTM, with the proposed method demonstrating superior performance through meticulous evaluation. Through an experimental framework that incorporates the ResNet50 network and a temporal frame sampling strategy (T = 16), the research meticulously adjusts video frame preprocessing for optimal deep learning model training and testing. Pretraining on the ImageNet dataset and employing a dynamic learning rate adjustment strategy, the study ensures a robust evaluation of the proposed method's classification accuracy. Notably, the proposed method achieved a remarkable mean accuracy of 99.6%, outperforming the two-stream LSTM model by 0.7% and showcasing its exceptional capability in accurately classifying a wide range of sports actions. The findings from this study highlight the significant potential of deep learning in enhancing video classification accuracy, especially in the context of sports action recognition. By effectively capturing both short-term and long-term motion dynamics through innovative network architectures and processing strategies, the proposed method sets a new benchmark in the field. This research contributes valuable insights into the evolving landscape of video classification, underscoring the importance of deep learning techniques in addressing complex classification challenges and paving the way for future advancements in the domain.

articleTitle: Research on Innovative Applications and Enhancement Strategies of Artificial Intelligence Algorithms in Criminal Justice
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: This paper discusses the application of artificial intelligence in the field of criminal justice. This paper introduces the current situation of artificial intelligence technology in criminal justice, including the application of case investigation, evidence analysis, sentencing prediction, etc., discusses how artificial intelligence can optimize and improve the criminal justice process, improve case handling efficiency and judicial justice, analyzes the important role of artificial intelligence in criminal case prediction and criminal behavior recognition, which can help the police prevent criminal behavior, discusses the auxiliary role of artificial intelligence in the court trial process, reduces the subjective factors of judges, improves the accuracy of judgment, summarizes the challenges and prospects of artificial intelligence in the field of criminal justice, and puts forward that further research and discussion are needed in protecting data privacy and ethical issues. In the future, the application of artificial intelligence in criminal justice will bring more innovations and changes to the judicial system.

articleTitle: Research on Short Video Copyright Protection by Video Similarity Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a network that integrates fine-grained regional features and spatiotemporal global features to improve the learning of short video similarity. Unlike previous research methods that solely rely on frame-level or video-level features for model training, our approach utilizes region max pooling to extract region-level features of images from the videos. Next, a sequence encoder with self and cross attention mechanisms is employed to capture both temporal and spatial information of the videos, creating a video-level feature that incorporates global spatiotemporal information. Finally, by combining the regional features and global video features, the model is trained to compute similarity scores between videos. In the experimental validation phase, we select the content-based video retrieval task as our proxy task, which also depends on similarity scores between videos, and achieve promising performance on relevant datasets. The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in short video copyright protection.

articleTitle: Study of Optimiser-Based Enhancement of Adversarial Attacks on Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: In an era where neural network robustness is paramount, our research investigates the role of optimization algorithms in enhancing the effectiveness of adversarial attacks. By integrating the Adam optimizer—renowned for its efficiency in neural network training—into the generation of adversarial examples, we propose the Adam Iterative Fast Gradient Method (AI-FGM). This method capitalizes on Adam's adaptive learning rates and momentum to fine-tune adversarial perturbations, facilitating a more precise exploitation of model vulnerabilities and improving the transferability of the attacks across different architectures. Our comprehensive experiments, conducted across seven diverse neural network models, both standard and adversarially trained, demonstrate that AI-FGM outperforms traditional attacks like Fast Gradient Sign Method (FGSM), Iterative Fast Gradient Sign Method (I-FGSM), and Momentum Iterative Fast Gradient Sign Method (MI-FGSM). The study reveals a significant decrease in model accuracy when subjected to AI-FGM, underscoring its potency. Furthermore, by adopting a fusion of logits approach, we extend the application of AI-FGM to ensemble networks, highlighting the method's scalability and effectiveness in targeting shared weaknesses within model clusters. This research underscores the potential of utilizing advanced optimization strategies in adversarial example generation and calls attention to the necessity for the development of more sophisticated neural network defense mechanisms to counteract such enhanced adversarial techniques.

articleTitle: Optimization of Interactive Intelligent Metro Public Facilities: Design Strategies and Satisfaction Analysis Based on User Experience Theory
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: With the promotion of China’s intelligent transportation policy, the impact of interactive intelligent systems and technologies in metro public facilities on passengers’ travel satisfaction has been increasingly emphasized; however, the current mechanism of influence between the level of intelligence and user satisfaction of metro public facilities has not yet been deeply explored. Therefore, this study takes Shanghai metro transportation as the background, and based on the extended technology acceptance model, seven research hypotheses based on the satisfaction of interactive intelligent metro public facilities are constructed by introducing four variables, namely, functional experience, content experience, interactive experience, and emotional experience, in user experience theory. Secondly, the study analyzed the data from the 299 valid samples collected through reliability, validity, normality, correlation, heat map, model fitness and structural equation modeling. The results show that all the research hypotheses are valid and there is a progressive relationship between different experience factors, in which functional experience affects perceived ease of use, emotional experience affects perceived usefulness, and perceived usefulness directly affects satisfaction. Based on the above research, four principle design strategies are innovatively proposed: "de-complicating and simplifying," "approachable," "striving for excellence," and "caring." Based on these strategies, a set of interactive smart metro public facilities and supporting HMIs and a set of WeChat mini-program HMIs are designed. Finally, the effectiveness of the four-principle design strategy is verified by conducting a usability assessment of this design solution.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Simulation Analysis of the Coupling Degree between Key Technologies of Big Data and Ningxia Energy System Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: The swift advancement of big data technology presents unparalleled opportunities for energy systems, driving modernization and sustainability in the energy field. To investigate the impact of key big data technologies on the Ningxia energy system, an IESAPI indicator system is constructed based on EAPI, introducing an Energy System Architecture Performance Index to quantify the score of Ningxia's energy system. Subsequently, the coupling relationship between big data technology and the Energy System Architecture Performance Index is examined, and a coupling model based on System Dynamics (SD) is established to quantitatively analyze the impact of big data technology on the Energy System Architecture Performance Index. The findings demonstrate that big data technology notably improves the energy system's prediction accuracy and overall performance. Big data technology has a positive effect on five aspects of the energy system: economic and social aspects, energy utilization, environmental friendliness, safety and reliability, and digital intelligence.

articleTitle: Optimal Single-Item Replenishment Scheme and Pricing Strategy for Vegetable Category Based on LSTM Time-Series Prediction Mixed Integer Programming Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: The replenishment and pricing of superstore vegetables is an important part of daily life, and the merchants' prediction and optimisation scheme for the future has gradually become an important issue in production and life. This paper focuses on the problem of total replenishment and pricing strategy of superstores, predicts and analyses the results based on LSTM time-series prediction, and finally gives the optimal total replenishment and pricing strategy of superstores in different scenarios. Firstly, the data are preprocessed to filter out the types of products available for sale from 24-30 June 2023 Meanwhile, based on the LSTM time-series prediction model, the basic relationship between short-term sales quantity and pricing is predicted. Then, under the premise of trying to meet the market demand for each category of vegetable goods, a mixed integer programming model aimed at maximising the benefits of the business dynasty is established, the 0-1 variable is introduced to constrain the selection of single products, and multiple constraints are established on the number of single products, the order quantity of single products, and the demand for each type of goods, which is solved to produce a profit of 1098.360 yuan on 1 July. Finally, based on a simple model perturbation, it is judged that the scheme is more reasonable and the result is superior, and finally gives the optimal single-item replenishment scheme and pricing strategy.

articleTitle: Abnormal Network Traffic Detection Algorithm Based on Improved Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: With the increasing complexity, automation, and intelligence of network attacks, new types of attacks are constantly emerging in the network, posing great challenges to network attack detection and timely response based on prior rules. In order to more effectively and accurately identify abnormal traffic, a network abnormal traffic detection algorithm based on improved convolutional neural networks is proposed. The algorithm first inputs the key features of traffic anomaly monitoring, converts them into color images through visualization technology, extracts higher dimensional features, and then uses neural structure search technology to find a lightweight convolutional network structure with high accuracy and less time consumption. The optimal model is used to output the type of traffic anomaly. The results indicate that the algorithm has a higher accuracy and the shortest classification time for a single image.

articleTitle: Distributed Cloud Simulation Architecture Combining Virtual and Real Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: With the deep integration of advanced manufacturing technology and the new generation of information technology, human-machine collaborative intelligent manufacturing has emerged as the core technology driving the development of the industrial sector. However, the human-machine collaborative intelligent manufacturing equipment exhibits high complexity and uncertainty in faults. The data silos that exist between equipment, personnel, systems, and platforms contribute to decreased productivity. Furthermore, the prolonged and costly technician training cycles add further obstacles. Therefore, a virtual-real integrated cloud simulation architecture is constructed using LVC (Live, Virtual, Constructive) simulation technology combined with a distributed computing framework. This architecture aims to achieve intelligent human-machine collaboration and real-time virtual-real interaction in industrial production. Real time monitoring of equipment and the entire production process through cloud simulation technology to optimize production processes and efficiency. The architecture supports simulation services such as intelligent task scheduling, human-machine collaborative manufacturing, adaptive flexible manufacturing, and production equipment precision and performance evaluation. The current architecture has just been proposed as a theoretical innovation for intelligent manufacturing cloud simulation solutions, but it has yet to be put into practice.

articleTitle: An Inquiry into the Implementation of Virtual Reality Technology for the Replication of an Advanced Agricultural Production Model in Changgang Township
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: In this study, we investigate the sophisticated production model employed in Changgang Township during the revolutionary period. It integrates virtual scene construction and group crowd simulation, implementing a group AI system to control virtual characters engaged in agricultural activities within hardware-constrained virtual environments. A dynamic lighting algorithm is devised to accurately represent luminance changes during day-night transitions, enhancing the scene's realism. Experimental findings highlight that optimizing lighting and vegetation models significantly enhances rendering quality on standard PCs, while the group AI system effectively manages dynamic pathfinding and high-density group behavior. This approach transcends limitations of text and images, providing an immersive virtual space that intuitively conveys the model's operational mechanism. Such immersive experiences are crucial for reconstructing intricate historical scenes using virtual reality technology.

articleTitle: A Two-phase Long Text Summarization Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: This paper proposes a two-stage text summary model to improve the quality of risk disclosure text summaries in prospectuses. The model combines extraction-based and generation-based methods. Firstly, the TextRank algorithm is used to extract key sentences from the original text. Then, the Text-To-Text Transfer Transformer (T5) model is applied to generate the summary. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed two-stage long text summary model can effectively enhance the quality of summaries, aiding investors in better understanding company risks. Compared to traditional methods, this model performs better in terms of accuracy and readability, and has practical value and broad application prospects.

articleTitle: LLM4ITD: Insider Threat Detection with Fine-Tuned Large Language Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: Recently, insider threat detection has been an important means to ensure data security. By analyzing user logs and finding significant deviations, existing methods have obtained some achievements. However, they still use handcrafted rules to transform logs into specific input forms, which is time-consuming and requires prior knowledge. Moreover, they extensively depend on a substantial amount of labeled malicious data which is hard to obtain. To address these identified issues, this paper proposes to use Large Language Models for Insider Threat Detection (LLM4ITD). Prompt construction module designs a new template to guide LLM4ITD in identifying potential malicious activities without specific rules. The fine-tuning module adopts parameter-efficient methods to fine-tune LLM4ITD, thus improving the accuracy of insider threat detection with limited labeled data. Extensive experiments on the CERT dataset demonstrate that LLM4ITD outperforms various state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Research on Supply Chain Demand Forecasting and Dynamic Adjustment Model Based on Big Data and Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: This paper conducts research on supply chain demand forecasting and dynamic adjustment based on big data and artificial intelligence technologies. Firstly, it analyzes the problems and limitations of traditional demand forecasting methods, as well as the challenges of supply chain demand forecasting. Secondly, it proposes the idea and methods of establishing dynamic adjustment models using big data and artificial intelligence technologies. By analyzing and mining massive data, combined with deep learning and neural network algorithms, an efficient and accurate supply chain demand forecasting model is established. Finally, through example verification and case analysis, the paper demonstrates the advantages and value of this model in practical applications. The research results indicate that the supply chain demand forecasting and dynamic adjustment model based on big data and artificial intelligence proposed in this study can effectively enhance the intelligence level of supply chain management, optimize operational efficiency, reduce costs, and improve enterprise competitiveness.

articleTitle: Research on Autonomous Obstacle Avoidance for Indoor UAVs Based on Vision and Laser
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: With the rapid development of UAVs, sensors, artificial intelligence technologies and control theories in recent years, autonomous indoor UAV flight still faces many challenges. The application of a single sensor is often constrained by its own limitations, which makes the stable positioning and flight of UAVs in complex indoor environments extremely difficult. To solve this problem, this paper develops an indoor autonomous flight obstacle avoidance system by combining a binocular camera with a 2D LiDAR sensor and correcting the UAV state by fusing flight control data. The experimental results show that the system successfully realises real-time positioning and map building in an unknown indoor environment, and at the same time is able to achieve one-key take-off and precise hovering of the quadcopter UAV. This not only provides an effective way to overcome sensor limitations, but also offers a completely new solution for the application of UAVs in complex indoor environments.

articleTitle: Computer Vision-Driven Multi-Target Recognition and Dynamic Tracking
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: This study provides an in-depth analysis of computer vision-based multi-target detection and intelligent tracking techniques, exploring the complexities of deploying these advanced techniques under different environmental conditions, with a particular focus on the challenges posed by different lighting scenarios. Through a comparative study including neural networks, binocular vision and a special emphasis on the approach presented in this paper, the study aims to reveal the relative performance and robustness of these techniques in unfavourable nighttime environments and favourable daytime conditions. Incorporating attentional mechanisms into computer vision target detection models marks a significant advancement that enhances feature extraction within the region of interest (ROI), thereby improving the quality of ROI classified features. This study provides insights into how intelligent multi-target tracking can be performed using computer vision techniques by applying spatio-temporal contextual algorithms within a Bayesian framework to analyse the correlation between the target object and the local scene, thereby improving the accuracy of real-time target localisation. An empirical evaluation using the Multi-target Tracking Accuracy (MOTA) metric was conducted to assess the consistency between the intelligent tracking results and the actual target trajectories, thus demonstrating the reliability of the proposed technique. By comprehensively comparing performance in night and daytime conditions, the study reveals the adaptations and limitations of current computer vision-based tracking methods, highlighting the need for specialised training, algorithm adaptation and integration of multimodal data to improve low-light tracking performance. In addition, the study highlights the urgent need for innovation and adoption of assistive technologies, especially for methods relying on binocular vision, to improve their practical application at different times of the day and in different environmental scenarios. This comprehensive survey not only demonstrates the current level of technological achievement, but also lays the groundwork for future advances that promise to significantly improve the accuracy, reliability and applicability of computer vision systems in the real world.

articleTitle: Personal Health Real-Time Analysis System Based on the Integration of Intelligent 5G Technology and Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: In order to verify the stability and accuracy of the temperature detection results of the system, the measurement results are observed by measuring the temperatures of different parts of the human body many times. The purpose of this paper is to build a personal health analysis system suitable for the masses through intelligent 5G technology and Internet of Things technology. According to the characteristics of wearable computing system, in order to solve the problem of limited resources such as CPU and energy of wearable devices, this paper introduces collaborative computing technology into wearable computing system, and designs an edge + multi-terminal collaborative computing framework for wearable computing system with multi-working modes. Through experimental research, it can be seen that the personal health real-time monitoring and analysis system proposed in this paper, which combines intelligent 5G technology and Internet of Things technology, has good practical application effect. Therefore, the integration of intelligent 5G technology and Internet of Things technology can be used to further improve the real-time measurement and analysis of human physiological parameters.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Predictive Analytics for Insurance Premiums
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: In this investigation, we delved into the utilization of three neural network models—namely, Artificial Neural Network (ANN), Recurrent Neural Network (INN), and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM)—for the prediction of medical insurance premiums. Using a dataset of 1070 training and 268 test samples, we evaluated their performance on non-time-series data, concentrating on Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), and Mean Absolute Percentage Error. The results revealed that the ANN model outperformed the RNN and LSTM models in terms of efficiency when dealing with non-time series data. This study accentuates the significance of judiciously selecting a model aligned with the specific characteristics of the dataset, underscoring the distinct advantages of the ANN model in our context. The outcomes furnish valuable insights for the medical insurance industry, offering guidance to insurance entities in the enhancement of their premium pricing.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Study on Patent Classification in the New Energy Field
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: This article preprocesses a large amount of patent literature data in the new energy field, uses machine learning models to identify and classify technical topics in the new energy field, and evaluates the machine learning model based on multiple evaluation indicators, attempting to find the most suitable machine learning model for patent classification in the new energy field. This article processes the dataset through methods such as word segmentation, removing stop words, and removing punctuation. CountVector is used for text feature extraction, LDA model is used for topic extraction, and corresponding probabilities are calculated. Then, the extracted topics, topic probabilities, and summary texts are input into three constructed machine learning models (LSTM, TextCNN, SVM) for training. After training, the models were evaluated and compared, and the most suitable machine learning model for patent literature technology topic classification in the new energy field was determined among the three models, achieving high accuracy and providing a reference for patent classification in the new energy field.

articleTitle: Analysis of Noise Data of Traction-Driven Passenger Lifts and Study of Its Causes
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: Through a comprehensive analysis of the noise and vibration of traction-driven passenger lifts in high-rise residential buildings, this study provides insights into the generation mechanisms and the actual impacts on the living environment. Two buildings were chosen for the investigation, with a particular emphasis on a section of the "G1" apartment block. Precise measurements of the noise and vibration produced by the operation of traction-driven passenger elevators were conducted. The results of the experiments show that the low-frequency band noise generated by traction-driven passenger lifts during operation, including structure-borne noise, has a significant impact on occupant comfort. Measurements indicate that noise in specific frequency ranges significantly affects occupants' perceptions in key areas such as living rooms and bedrooms. Specifically, impacts in the 250 Hz range are most noticeable in living rooms, while in bedrooms they are concentrated in the 125 Hz range. This trend was confirmed for both noise and vibration. In addition, the measurements show that the energy distribution of noise from traction-driven passenger lifts is higher than the general ambient noise range, emphasising its low-frequency characteristics. Based on these findings, we emphasise the dominant role of low-frequency band noise for traction-driven passenger lift noise and thus suggest possible solutions to improve the living environment. Optimisation of the structural design of the lift, improvement of the acoustic insulation system and implementation of vibration damping measures are recommended for the low-frequency band noise. These recommendations aim to improve lift performance and mitigate its negative impact on the living environment, and provide useful guidance for future lift design and operation.

articleTitle: Using Artificial Intelligence for Intelligent Ideological and Political Education Teaching
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: In the context of integrating artificial intelligence (AI) into ideological and political education, recent explorations have revealed significant strides in enhancing teaching methodologies and student engagement. The adoption of a two-tier dynamic student model, transcending traditional models with its network-like structure, allows for a comprehensive and dynamic evaluation of student characteristics. This model is further empowered by fuzzy comprehensive evaluation algorithms, which translate qualitative aspects of student assessment into quantifiable metrics, enabling a nuanced and objective evaluation process. The integration of practical video courses and offline exercises, as evidenced by near-perfect attendance rates and active participation, suggests a deepened student understanding and interest in the subject matter. However, the application of AI in education must balance technological advancements with the preservation of humanistic values central to ideological and political education. While AI offers innovative tools for enhancing educational practices, its use must align with the core objectives of meaningful learning and enlightenment. The challenge lies in leveraging AI's technical prowess while ensuring that it complements rather than overshadows the humanistic essence of education. This integration presents a unique opportunity to enhance the effectiveness and relevance of teaching methodologies, ensuring that the core objectives of education are not only preserved but also enriched in this new digital era. In conclusion, the exploration into AI's role in ideological and political education indicates a promising future where technology and human values coexist harmoniously, ensuring that the teaching and learning of such subjects remain impactful and relevant. The key lies in creating a balanced blend of technological innovation and the preservation of essential educational values.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Portfolio Optimization Model Based on Big Data and Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: Based on big data and artificial intelligence technology, this paper studies the intelligent portfolio optimization model. With the rapid development of big data and artificial intelligence technology, the model has received more and more attention in the financial field. Firstly, through the big data analysis of market data and asset performance, this paper establishes a portfolio containing multiple asset classes; Then, artificial intelligence algorithm is used to predict the historical performance of assets, so as to improve the return of portfolio and reduce the risk; Finally, the portfolio is adjusted and optimized by the optimization algorithm to maintain stability and efficiency in different market environments. The results show that the Intelligent Portfolio Optimization Model Based on big data and artificial intelligence can effectively improve the yield of the portfolio and reduce the investment risk, which has important guiding significance for investors to make wise investment decisions in complex financial markets.

articleTitle: Attention-Guided Oriented Bounding Box Real-Time Image Analytics Model for Dense Wheat Imperfect Grains and Impurities
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: Impurities and imperfect grains in dense wheat are critical factors affecting wheat quality and secondary production. Despite the significance, detecting dense wheat grains still faces challenges, mainly due to poor detection accuracy and severe leakage. These issues hinder the model from meeting the reliability and real-time detection requirements in practical scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose an attention-guided oriented bounding box network (AG-OBBNet) for real-time detection of dense wheat imperfect grains and impurities. Firstly, the oriented bounding box method(OBB) is integrated to introduce the orientation of wheat grains into the YOLOX framework, which dramatically improves the accuracy of image analysis and result information visualization. Next, we construct a novel strong feature extraction network that integrates low-dimensional localization features with semantic features enhanced by DS-CSP and a global attention mechanism before fusion. This network facilitates deep mining of semantic information, improving wheat grain classification, reducing computational overhead, and enhancing the utilization of low-dimensional localization features to improve the leakage detection problem in dense wheat grains. Finally, we introduce the Focal-EIOU loss function for faster convergence speed and better localization effects, replacing the original IOU loss function to further enhance model detection performance. To validate the effectiveness and generalization ability of the model, we construct a dense wheat grain dataset (DWGD) categorized into 12 different classes. Experimental results indicate an average accuracy (mAP) of 96.4% for detecting imperfections and impurities in wheat grains, with the Frame Per Second(FPS) of 148.6. Additionally, the model features fewer parameters and meets real-time images analytics and visualization requirements in practical scenarios.

articleTitle: Tennis Enhancing Tennis Match Strategies through Momentum Change Analysis and Prediction Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: In the domain of professional tennis, the occurrence of significant fluctuations in match dominance is a common phenomenon, often ascribed to the elusive concept of "momentum." Although players intuitively sense these shifts in momentum, quantitatively capturing and measuring them presents a considerable challenge. Moreover, it is critical to examine the impact of specific match events on the evolution of momentum. In response to these challenges, the current study undertakes a comprehensive modeling analysis of tennis match data from the year 2023. The foundation of the analysis is a meticulous examination and preprocessing of the available data, which ensures the robustness of the subsequent modeling efforts. By equating the differential in player momentum to observable fluctuations in match dynamics, the study constructs a predictive framework. The research employs sophisticated feature engineering to identify appropriate indicators that serve as inputs to various predictive models. These models encompass integrated approaches, as well as linear and nonlinear methods, all rigorously validated using a 10-fold cross-validation technique. Through an exhaustive GridSearch approach for hyperparameter optimization, three predominant models emerge: Support Vector Regression (SVR), Random Forest (RF), and XGBoost regression. These models are ingeniously combined into a Stacking model, which culminates in a highly accurate player match volatility prediction model, boasting an R-squared value of 0.9343. The analysis identifies the game score, the opponent's score, and the serving turn as pivotal factors contributing to match fluctuation. Based on these insights, the study advises players to conduct an in-depth analysis of their opponents' momentum shifts and adjust their strategies accordingly. Additionally, players are recommended to introspect their own momentum changes in parallel scenarios to gain a deeper comprehension of their performance. This strategic self-awareness is imperative for athletes to adapt and refine their tactics, thereby securing a sustained competitive advantage in the high-stakes arena of professional tennis.

articleTitle: Research on Classified Information Security of Computer Network Based on Big Data Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Interactive Intelligent Systems and Techniques (IIST)
abstract: Confidential information security in computer networks has always been an important topic of concern in the field of information technology. With the rapid development of information technology, big data clustering algorithm, as a powerful analysis tool, shows a wide range of application prospects in the research of classified information security in computer networks. Based on the big data clustering algorithm, this study aims to deeply investigate its application in the field of computer network classified information security. Three datasets of different sizes were selected to ensure the statistical significance of the experiment through a quantitative perspective. The study focused on the percentage distribution of intrusion behaviours, including four types of DoS, R2L, U2R and Probe. Through the creation of tests using various numbers of clustering clusters K, the effectiveness of the cloud model semi-supervised clustering algorithm in intrusion detection is methodically assessed. According to the experimental data, there is a progressive rise in the value of K along with an increasing trend in the false alarm rate. At K=20, the detection rate peaks at 91.77%, while the false alarm rate is very low at 8.56%. This highlights that the cloud model semi-supervised clustering algorithm achieves the best intrusion detection results for a specific number of clusters. Comparison results with other algorithms show that the algorithm exhibits higher detection rates at different K values, providing strong performance support for diverse intrusion behaviours. Overall, the experimental design and analysis results of this study provide in-depth understanding and strong support for the application of big data clustering algorithms in classified information security in computer networks. The algorithm's superior performance in the field of intrusion detection has made substantial contributions to technological progress in the field of network security.
